报导指出，爱阿华州已成为共和党能否守住众议院多数席次的重要指标。福斯新闻网的选情评估显示，该州4个联邦众议院选区中，除了1席仍被视为共和党稳定掌握，其余3席都可能易手。其中，联邦众议员努恩（Zach Nunn）及米勒－米克斯（Mariannette Miller-Meeks）所属选区被列为民主党略占优势，准备接替退休联邦众议员欣森（Ashley Hinson）的共和党候选人米契尔（Joe Mitchell），则面临胜负难料的选战。 共和党在爱阿华州面临的压力，不只来自民主党动员，也与选民对经济及特朗普政府政策的不满有关。爱阿华州是美国重要农业州，农民与农业相关产业对设备及原物料成本相当敏感。特朗普政府的关税政策推高部分农业设备及其他材料价格，美中贸易战也使中国对美国商品采取报复措施，让仰赖出口的美国农民承受压力。 此外，特朗普决定进口外国牛肉，也成为爱阿华州部分共和党候选人必须面对的争议。当地农业产业与农民是共和党的重要支持基础，若选民认为政府政策损害本地生产者利益，可能影响他们对共和党的支持。 特朗普政府上月宣布，计划在爱阿华州李县（Lee County）兴建一座价值150亿美元的钢铁厂，试图缓解钢铁关税带来的部分冲击。不过，相关投资计画能否及时改善选民对物价与经济的感受，仍有待观察。 爱阿华州的选情变化，也反映共和党在全美乡村地区面临的更广泛问题。过去20年来，美国乡村选民逐渐成为共和党的重要票源。 2024年总统大选时，近三分之二的乡村选民支持特朗普，使共和党得以在许多农村及小城镇选区建立明显优势。然而，最新调查显示，如今表示将在11月期中选举继续支持共和党的乡村选民已不到一半。 福斯新闻网分析，生活成本上涨是造成不满的重要因素。近期调查中，19%的乡村选民将生活成本上升列为最主要的经济问题，汽油与能源价格也名列前茅。特朗普政府试图透过宣传就业成长及人工智能（AI）产业带来的经济机会，降低民众对经济的疑虑，但乡村选民对经济前景仍缺乏信心。 调查显示，认为美国经济状况良好的乡村选民不到四分之一。另有8%受访者将缺乏工作机会及失业列为最主要的经济问题，只有28%认为自己居住的社区有良好或极佳的就业机会。 数据中心的扩张也成为部分乡村居民关切的议题。虽然只有2%的乡村选民将数据中心列为最主要的经济问题，但换算下来，每50名乡村选民就有1人认为，数据中心带来的问题比住房、生活成本或找工作更加严重。 上述经济压力使共和党在爱阿华州、俄亥俄州等美国中西部地区面临更激烈的竞争，也让特朗普2024年曾以两位数百分点优势胜出的部分乡村选区，如今出现两党候选人支持度落在民调误差范围内的情况。 共和党在部分传统优势地区面临的挑战，也反映在候选人的竞选策略上。福斯新闻网指出，怀俄明州共和党联邦参议员候选人葛雷（Chuck Gray）本周推出的电视竞选广告，完全没有提到特朗普或共和党。 这项安排格外引人注意，因为特朗普2024年在怀俄明州获得71.6%的选票，创下他在各州选举中的最高得票率。即使如此，共和党候选人仍选择不在广告中强调与特朗普或共和党的关系，显示部分候选人可能希望将竞选焦点放在自身政见，而非总统的全国性形象。 乡村地区投票率下滑，或部分选民转而支持其他候选人，也可能让共和党在佛罗里达州、密西西比州及南卡罗来纳州等地面临更接近的选战。 今年爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内布拉斯加州及南达科他州的联邦参议员选举，也出现另一项可能影响共和党选情的因素：多名无党籍候选人出马挑战共和党候选人。这些候选人主打反建制立场，提出限制国会议员任期、禁止游说等政见，并将打击贪腐列为重要诉求。福斯新闻网近期民调显示，贪腐是选民最关切的问题之一，让这类主张具有一定吸引力。 这些无党籍候选人都表示，若当选，不会加入民主党或共和党的党团，部分人更主张成立独立党团。民主党在这些州的整体形象仍然偏弱，因此已退出其中3州的相关竞选。蒙大拿州民主党候选人则仍留在选票上，但支持度持续下滑。 福斯新闻网分析，过去当民主党候选人缺乏胜算时，部分民主党支持者可能选择不投票，让共和党候选人以较小差距获胜。但今年无党籍候选人提供了另一种选择，可能吸引对两大政党都不满的选民，进一步压缩共和党的胜选幅度。

title: 英国政府批准北海一处备受争议的天然气田开采项目 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 20:09 英国政府周三批准了在北海开采备受争议的“杰克多”（Jackdaw）天然气项目的计划，旨在展现“务实”态度，以加强该国的能源安全——目前英国正因中东战争导致能源价格飙升而面临压力。 法新社伦敦报道，英国政府批准开采杰克多项目的消息得到了保守派反对党和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的欢迎，但遭到环保主义者的谴责。 工党政府在一份声明中表示，位于阿伯丁以东约240公里的杰克多（Jackdaw）油田开采计划获得批准，这将“保住数百个就业岗位，并为英国经济注入约29亿英镑（34.5亿欧元）” 他指出，所生产的天然气“最早将于本月底”开始供应家庭和商户，且国内产量在高峰期将增长约6%。 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆在议会为这个“务实做法”进行了辩护，此前他被质询了该新项目产生的温室气体排放问题。 伦敦方面表示，仍致力于在2050年前实现碳中和，并向可再生能源转型。伯纳姆先生称：“但即使按照我们雄心勃勃的气候发展路径，未来几十年里，我们仍需要石油和天然气来满足部分能源需求”。 英国政府还宣布设立一项规模为20亿英镑（约合24亿欧元）的生态转型基金，资金来源为北海油气收入。 账单“不会更便宜” 反对在北海进行新钻探的人士反驳称，任何额外的化石能源生产都会导致能源消耗增加，只会延缓能源转型。他们还强调，消费者面临的能源价格并不会因此下降。 工党在2024年上台执政前曾承诺，不会在北海发放新的钻探许可证。 不过，这些承诺并不妨碍批准现有许可证范围内的项目。挪威国家石油公司（Equinor）首席执行官安德斯·奥佩达尔（Anders Opedal）10月初就此接受采访时指出，杰克多“Jackdaw”项目便是如此——该项目最初于2022年由保守党批准，随后经历了一场旷日持久的法律诉讼。 这家挪威国家石油巨头与壳牌（Shell）共同组建了Adura合资企业，主要负责该天然气田的开发。 据Rystad Energy的分析师马特·库珀告诉法新社：“所有基础设施都已就位，所有油井都已钻探完毕”。 距离预算案公布还有一周时间，而受燃油价格上涨推动的通胀率在9月份已达到3.5%，英国首相伯纳姆还强调，这一预计寿命长达11年的天然气项目“将有助于让数百万家庭在这个冬天保持温暖”。 不过，能源部长米亚塔·法恩布莱在接受LBC电台采访时承认：“这并不会让账单金额降低。” “全力以赴” 伯纳姆首相仍面临保守党的压力，该党周三呼吁批准“罗斯班克”项目——这是一个主要位于北海、设得兰群岛以西的石油项目，其法律和政治进程与“杰克道”项目如出一辙。 罗斯班克项目的碳氢化合物储量更大，但其投产所需时间更长，且开采出的石油将被出口到其他国家进行炼制。 伍德·麦肯齐公司的詹姆斯·里德向法新社解释道：“由于国内炼油能力有限，英国大陆架生产的大部分石油都被出口到欧洲的炼油厂。” 政府尚未透露何时就此事作出决定。法恩布莱女士强调，“杰克道”和“罗斯班克”是“两个截然不同的项目”，并特别指出，与原油不同，天然气将直接注入管网。 除了国内压力，英国政府数月来还面临着唐纳德·特朗普呼吁在北海增加钻探的压力。 美国总统在自己的社交媒体平台“Truth Social”上发文称，批准“杰克道”项目是“对英国财富和繁荣的极好消息”。 他补充道：“他们应该在北海钻探方面全力以赴！！！”

title: 法国总理与工会代表会面 马克龙在卡塔尔呼吁采取强硬立场 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 19:23 在又一个实施局部宵禁的夜晚过后，法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼于周三与工会组织代表会面，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙再次呼吁对暴力行为实施者采取“强硬态度”。 法国总理勒科尔尼在新一轮暴力示威前夕，周三上午会见可工会代表讨论安全问题，以防暴力事件重演。对方要求政府就其诉求作出政策回应。 正在卡塔尔结束为期三天海湾之行的法国总统表示，国家最高层在惩处滋事者时“绝不能手软”。 马克龙还宣布将于周四上午与情报部门举行会议，就上周末的事件进行“透明说明”，而周六法国将迎来新一轮抗议活动。 上周六，在抗议“生活成本高企”的示威活动期间，法国多座城市发生了抢劫和暴力事件，期间全法共有3000家商铺遭到抢劫和破坏。 在多哈，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙为自己备受批评的出访行程辩护，承诺法国人将从已达成的能源协议中获得“应有的回报”。他提到，已从卡塔尔获得冬季期间“相当于每月2太瓦时（TWh）的液化天然气（LNG）”。 他还谴责了那些“利用法国（暴力）事件大做文章”的“外国领导人”，此言暗指美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡针对法国暴力事件所发表的言论。 尽管未发现这些事件中存在“明显的外国干涉”，但马克龙谴责了“外国对信息的操纵，这导致许多人——包括外国领导人——发表了既不可接受又愚蠢的言论”。 他最后强调，“任何暴力都是不合法的”，“无论是言语暴力、肢体暴力，还是针对财产或人员的暴力”，并认为在这个问题上“有太多人态度模棱两可”。 在政治层面，法国各派人士周三再次谴责了马克龙政府在这场暴力中失职。 法国总工会（CGT）今天正在考虑是否呼吁加入部分“黄背心”运动成员发起的周六示威号召——该工会的巴黎分部此前已响应了这一号召。 此外，希腊部分学校师生以“法国指明方向”的口号发起示威行动，并呼吁希腊公共部门全面罢工。

title: 台湾在选举前谴责中国网络攻击和散布虚假信息 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 21/10/2026 - 18:13 法新社21日台北消息，台湾情报部门周二表示，中国已加剧针对台湾的网络攻击和散布虚假信息行动，而台湾正准备于11月底举行地方选举。 据台湾国家安全局周二提交给立法院的报告指出：2026年前九个月，台湾平均每天遭受260万次网络攻击，自6月以来这一现象愈演愈烈。 该报告指出，中国“网络军队”将台湾的学术和科研领域、电信行业及国防供应链，作为攻击目标，旨在“干扰台湾政府的国防行动、破坏国际合作并窃取敏感技术”。 另据台湾自由时报引述台湾国安局报告，近期已发现中共结合人工智慧（AI）技术进行网路攻击，包括运用AI代理工具，自动侦察及扫描“我国政府网站的安全弱点，试图提高网路渗透效率”。 报告进一步指出，中共已将AI运用于网路攻击的不同阶段，包括目标侦察、零日漏洞挖掘及社交电邮攻击等活动，藉由自动化工具加快攻击节奏，并提升寻找系统弱点及渗透目标的效率。 据法新社引述台湾情报部门统计，过去九个月内，中共散布了超过250万条虚假信息，而去年同期这一数字约为170万条，主要通过Facebook和Threads平台传播。 这个报告指出，中共“利用了各种渠道”，包括技术和人力手段，“以影响我国选民的偏好和选举结果”。

title: 黄仁勋下台会成为人工智能泡沫破裂的开端吗
description: BEN CASSELMAN2026年11月13日在其他行业陷入困境之际，数据中心建设热潮成为美国经济增长的重要推动力，而英伟达一直在为这股建设热潮提供融资支持。 Callaghan O'Hare for The New York Times As investors have pumped trillions of dollars into artificial intelligence companies, chipmakers and data center developers, the economy has come to rely on the industry as its primary — some would argue only — reliable driver of growth. 随着投资者向人工智能公司、芯片制造商和数据中心开发商投入数万亿美元，人工智能行业已成为美国经济增长最主要的可靠动力，甚至有人认为是唯一的可靠动力。 No company has been more central to that growth than Nvidia, whose chips fill the data centers that power A.I. and whose money helps to finance them. And, at least until this week, it was impossible to imagine Nvidia without Jensen Huang, its high-flying, leather-clad co-founder and chief executive. 在这一增长过程中，没有哪家企业比英伟达更为核心。为人工智能提供算力的数据中心里布满了英伟达的芯片，英伟达的资金也为这些数据中心的建设提供了支持。而且，至少在本周之前，人们很难想象英伟达可以没有黄仁勋：这位身穿皮夹克、风头正劲的联合创始人兼首席执行官。 All of which means that Mr. Huang’s resignation on Thursday, following a made-for-Hollywood series of scandals, matters not just for the company and its investors, but for virtually every American. 所有这些意味着，在一连串堪比好莱坞剧情的丑闻之后，黄仁勋周四辞职所产生的影响不仅关系到英伟达及其投资者，而且也与几乎每一个美国人息息相关。 Or, as Aaron Klein, an expert in financial regulation at the Brookings Institution, put it: “Can one C.E.O.’s sex life take down the economy?” 正如布鲁金斯学会金融监管专家亚伦·克莱因所说：“一位首席执行官的性生活能把整个经济拖垮吗？” The answer, in a literal sense, is almost certainly no. No one believes that Mr. Huang’s resignation will, by itself, bring the A.I. boom to an end, let alone plunge the economy into a recession. Nvidia’s stock price tumbled on Thursday, but the broader market barely budged. 从字面意义上说，答案几乎肯定是否定的。没人认为黄仁勋的辞职本身就会终结人工智能热潮，更不用说让经济陷入衰退了。英伟达股价周四大跌，但大盘几乎没有波动。 But Mr. Klein’s quip spoke to the unique role that Mr. Huang played at Nvidia, and that his company has played in the A.I. build out. 不过，克莱因这句半开玩笑的话道出了黄仁勋在英伟达、英伟达在人工智能基础设施建设中所扮演的独特角色。 Nvidia controls about 90 percent of the market for the most advanced chips used to train and run A.I. models. The turmoil at the company could create an opening for competitors such as AMD and Intel to encroach on that market share. But there is little reason to think that Mr. Huang’s resignation will threaten Nvidia’s ability to develop and produce the chips it has promised its customers. 英伟达在用于训练和运行人工智能模型的最先进芯片市场上占据约90%的份额。公司的动荡可能为AMD和英特尔等竞争对手创造机会，蚕食其市场份额。但几乎没有理由认为，黄仁勋辞职会危及英伟达研发和生产已向客户承诺交付的芯片的能力。 But Nvidia isn’t just the dominant chipmaker. It is also the “central bank of A.I.,” helping to finance the industry’s growth through a series of complex deals with its customers and suppliers. 然而，英伟达不仅是占据主导地位的芯片制造商，它还是“人工智能产业的中央银行”，通过与客户和供应商之间一系列复杂的交易安排为整个行业的发展提供融资支持。 When OpenAI signed a lease for a 10-gigawatt data center in Ohio in August, it was Nvidia that provided $105 billion in loan guarantees. Days later, the company teamed up with several Wall Street firms to create a $500 billion fund to help finance A.I.-related infrastructure. Nvidia owns a more than 10 percent stake in CoreWeave, a big data center operator, and has guaranteed billions of dollars in its loans. 今年8月，OpenAI签约租用俄亥俄州一座规模达10吉瓦的数据中心时，英伟达提供了1050亿美元的贷款担保。几天后，英伟达又与多家华尔街公司合作，设立一只规模达5000亿美元的基金，为人工智能相关基础设施提供融资。英伟达还持有大型数据中心运营商CoreWeave超过10%的股份，并为其数十亿美元的贷款提供了担保。 英伟达股价周四大幅下跌，但大盘几乎没有波动。 Its loan commitments and financing arrangements would make Nvidia the 10th largest bank in the country, according to an estimate from Ryan Cummings, the chief of staff for the Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research. 根据斯坦福经济政策研究所主管瑞安·卡明斯的估计，英伟达的贷款承诺和融资安排将使其成为美国第十大银行。 “Nvidia is at the center of this circular financing, and obviously at the center of Nvidia is Jensen Huang,” Mr. Cummings said. “He has been the driving force, pretty inarguably, behind a lot of the A.I. build-out.” “英伟达处于这种循环融资的中心，显然英伟达的中心是黄仁勋，”卡明斯说。“无可争辩，他一直是大量人工智能建设背后的驱动力。” Without Mr. Huang in charge, Nvidia’s role could change, Mr. Cummings said. And while it is possible that other companies will step in to fill the gap, that isn’t guaranteed. 卡明斯表示，黄仁勋不再掌舵后，英伟达所扮演的角色可能发生变化。其他企业或许会填补它留下的空缺，但这并非板上钉钉。 Mr. Huang’s departure comes at a delicate time for the A.I. industry. There have been signs in recent months that investors are growing more skeptical that companies will deliver returns that justify the huge investments they are making in A.I., or at least that those returns could take longer than expected to materialize. 黄仁勋离职之际，人工智能产业正处于一个敏感时期。近几个月来，已有迹象表明，投资者越来越怀疑，企业能否从人工智能领域的巨额投入中获得足以证明这些投资合理的回报，即便最终能够获得这样的回报，所需的时间也可能比预期更长。 And Democrats’ sweeping victories in last week’s midterm elections could lead to new restrictions on data center construction, which could jeopardize the industry’s boom. 而民主党在上周中期选举中的大胜可能导致对数据中心建设的新限制，这可能危及该行业的繁荣。 “At a point when people are already on edge about this trade, it’s another piece of uncertainty,” Mr. Cummings said. “在人们已经对这波投资行情感到紧张不安的时候，这又增添了一层不确定性，”卡明斯说。 In the past, when confidence in the A.I. story has wavered, Mr. Huang and Nvidia have been the ones to calm doubts, reporting huge sales figures or stepping in to provide financing to data center projects whose future seemed in jeopardy. This time, it isn’t clear who will fill the void. 过去，每当市场对人工智能的发展前景产生疑虑，总是黄仁勋和英伟达出面打消这些疑虑：要么公布亮眼的销售业绩，要么为前景堪忧的数据中心项目提供融资支持。而这一次，谁能填补他们留下的空缺尚不得而知。 “Could the single largest A.I. company C.E.O.’s impropriety be the start of the pop of the bubble?” Mr. Klein asked. “Yes, as crazy as that sounds. Particularly when one company is so central.” “全球最大人工智能公司的首席执行官行为失当会不会成为泡沫破裂的导火索？”克莱因问。“有可能。听起来再疯狂不过，但当一家公司处于如此核心的地位时，确实可能发生。” Bubbles are inherently unpredictable: It isn’t clear, ahead of time, what will flip the psychological switch that causes them to burst. The muted market reaction of financial markets to the news on Thursday suggests that investors aren’t losing faith in the A.I. trade. 泡沫本身就难以预测：事先谁也无法确定，究竟什么会触动投资者心理上的开关，导致泡沫破裂。金融市场对周四消息的温和反应表明，投资者并未对人工智能交易失去信心。 But Mr. Klein said the Nvidia mess should be a warning that the complex web of A.I. financing arrangements is threatening financial stability. 但克莱因表示，英伟达的这场风波应该敲响警钟：人工智能产业错综复杂的融资关系正在威胁金融稳定。 “It looks like the financial regulators are sleeping through the alarm clock,” he said. “金融监管机构似乎连闹钟响了都还在睡觉，”他说。 If Nvidia’s new leadership takes a more cautious approach to financing, that could have implications for the broader economy. The data center boom has helped to prop up the construction and manufacturing industries, at a time when tariffs, high interest rates and uncertainty have limited demand from other sectors. 如果英伟达的新管理层在融资方面采取更加谨慎的态度，可能会对整体经济产生影响。在关税、高利率和不确定性抑制其他行业需求之际，数据中心建设热潮一直在支撑建筑业和制造业的发展。 Still, the breakneck pace of the A.I. build-out has also pushed up inflation and raised borrowing costs. Many economists argue that a modest slowdown would be healthy. 不过，人工智能基础设施建设的狂飙突进也推高了通货膨胀和借贷成本。许多经济学家认为，适度放缓反而有益于经济健康。 The more immediate risk, economists say, is that a loss of confidence in the A.I. story leads to a steep drop in the stock market. The strength of the market has helped prop up consumer spending even as wage growth has cooled. 经济学家指出，更迫在眉睫的风险是，投资者对人工智能前景失去信心，导致股市大幅下跌。尽管工资增长已经放缓，股市的强劲帮助支撑了消费者支出。 If the A.I. trade unravels because of an abrupt curtailment in investment, “that is more recessionary,” said Pooja Sriram, an economist at Barclays. “That’s when there is a more material shakeout in the stock market that transcends to how consumers feel. Balance sheets are hit and that could escalate very quickly into a downturn.” 巴克莱经济学家普贾·斯里拉姆说，如果人工智能交易因投资突然大幅缩减而瓦解，“那将更容易引发经济衰退”。“届时，股市将出现更为严重的震荡，并进一步影响消费者信心。人们的资产负债状况受到冲击，局面可能迅速恶化，最终演变成经济衰退。” Colby Smith对本文有报道贡献。 Ben Casselman是《纽约时报》首席经济记者，他从事经济报道近20年。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

And, at least until this week, it was impossible to imagine Nvidia without Jensen Huang, its high-flying, leather-clad co-founder and chief executive. 在这一增长过程中，没有哪家企业比英伟达更为核心。为人工智能提供算力的数据中心里布满了英伟达的芯片，英伟达的资金也为这些数据中心的建设提供了支持。而且，至少在本周之前，人们很难想象英伟达可以没有黄仁勋：这位身穿皮夹克、风头正劲的联合创始人兼首席执行官。 All of which means that Mr. Huang’s resignation on Thursday , following a made-for-Hollywood series of scandals, matters not just for the company and its investors, but for virtually every American. 所有这些意味着，在一连串堪比好莱坞剧情的丑闻之后， 黄仁勋周四辞职 所产生的影响不仅关系到英伟达及其投资者，而且也与几乎每一个美国人息息相关。 Or, as Aaron Klein, an expert in financial regulation at the Brookings Institution, put it: “Can one C.E.O.’s sex life take down the economy?” 正如布鲁金斯学会金融监管专家亚伦·克莱因所说：“一位首席执行官的性生活能把整个经济拖垮吗？” The answer, in a literal sense, is almost certainly no. No one believes that Mr. Huang’s resignation will, by itself, bring the A.I. boom to an end, let alone plunge the economy into a recession. Nvidia’s stock price tumbled on Thursday , but the broader market barely budged. 从字面意义上说，答案几乎肯定是否定的。没人认为黄仁勋的辞职本身就会终结人工智能热潮，更不用说让经济陷入衰退了。英伟达股价 周四大跌 ，但大盘几乎没有波动。 But Mr. Klein’s quip spoke to the unique role that Mr. Huang played at Nvidia, and that his company has played in the A.I. build out. 不过，克莱因这句半开玩笑的话道出了黄仁勋在英伟达、英伟达在人工智能基础设施建设中所扮演的独特角色。 Nvidia controls about 90 percent of the market for the most advanced chips used to train and run A.I. models. The turmoil at the company could create an opening for competitors such as AMD and Intel to encroach on that market share. But there is little reason to think that Mr. Huang’s resignation will threaten Nvidia’s ability to develop and produce the chips it has promised its customers. 英伟达在用于训练和运行人工智能模型的最先进芯片市场上占据约90%的份额。公司的动荡可能为AMD和英特尔等竞争对手创造机会，蚕食其市场份额。但几乎没有理由认为，黄仁勋辞职会危及英伟达研发和生产已向客户承诺交付的芯片的能力。 But Nvidia isn’t just the dominant chipmaker. It is also the “central bank of A.I.,” helping to finance the industry’s growth through a series of complex deals with its customers and suppliers. 然而，英伟达不仅是占据主导地位的芯片制造商，它还是“人工智能产业的中央银行”，通过与客户和供应商之间一系列复杂的交易安排为整个行业的发展提供融资支持。 When OpenAI signed a lease for a 10-gigawatt data center in Ohio in August, it was Nvidia that provided $105 billion in loan guarantees. Days later, the company teamed up with several Wall Street firms to create a $500 billion fund to help finance A.I.-related infrastructure. Nvidia owns a more than 10 percent stake in CoreWeave, a big data center operator, and has guaranteed billions of dollars in its loans. 今年8月，OpenAI签约租用俄亥俄州一座规模达10吉瓦的数据中心时，英伟达提供了1050亿美元的贷款担保。几天后，英伟达又与多家华尔街公司合作，设立一只规模达5000亿美元的基金，为人工智能相关基础设施提供融资。英伟达还持有大型数据中心运营商CoreWeave超过10%的股份，并为其数十亿美元的贷款提供了担保。 英伟达股价周四大幅下跌，但大盘几乎没有波动。 Its loan commitments and financing arrangements would make Nvidia the 10th largest bank in the country, according to an estimate from Ryan Cummings, the chief of staff for the Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research. 根据斯坦福经济政策研究所主管瑞安·卡明斯的估计，英伟达的贷款承诺和融资安排将使其成为美国第十大银行。 “Nvidia is at the center of this circular financing, and obviously at the center of Nvidia is Jensen Huang,” Mr. Cummings said. “He has been the driving force, pretty inarguably, behind a lot of the A.I. build-out.” “英伟达处于这种循环融资的中心，显然英伟达的中心是黄仁勋，”卡明斯说。“无可争辩，他一直是大量人工智能建设背后的驱动力。” Without Mr. Huang in charge, Nvidia’s role could change, Mr. Cummings said. And while it is possible that other companies will step in to fill the gap, that isn’t guaranteed. 卡明斯表示，黄仁勋不再掌舵后，英伟达所扮演的角色可能发生变化。其他企业或许会填补它留下的空缺，但这并非板上钉钉。 Mr. Huang’s departure comes at a delicate time for the A.I. industry. There have been signs in recent months that investors are growing more skeptical that companies will deliver returns that justify the huge investments they are making in A.I., or at least that those returns could take longer than expected to materialize. 黄仁勋离职之际，人工智能产业正处于一个敏感时期。近几个月来，已有迹象表明，投资者越来越怀疑，企业能否从人工智能领域的巨额投入中获得足以证明这些投资合理的回报，即便最终能够获得这样的回报，所需的时间也可能比预期更长。 And Democrats’ sweeping victories in last week’s midterm elections could lead to new restrictions on data center construction, which could jeopardize the industry’s boom. 而民主党在上周中期选举中的大胜可能 导致对数据中心建设的新限制 ，这可能危及该行业的繁荣。 “At a point when people are already on edge about this trade, it’s another piece of uncertainty,” Mr. Cummings said. “在人们已经对这波投资行情感到紧张不安的时候，这又增添了一层不确定性，”卡明斯说。 In the past, when confidence in the A.I. story has wavered, Mr. Huang and Nvidia have been the ones to calm doubts, reporting huge sales figures or stepping in to provide financing to data center projects whose future seemed in jeopardy. This time, it isn’t clear who will fill the void. 过去，每当市场对人工智能的发展前景产生疑虑，总是黄仁勋和英伟达出面打消这些疑虑：要么公布亮眼的销售业绩，要么为前景堪忧的数据中心项目提供融资支持。而这一次，谁能填补他们留下的空缺尚不得而知。 “Could the single largest A.I. company C.E.O.’s impropriety be the start of the pop of the bubble?” Mr. Klein asked. “Yes, as crazy as that sounds. Particularly when one company is so central.” “全球最大人工智能公司的首席执行官行为失当会不会成为泡沫破裂的导火索？”克莱因问。“有可能。听起来再疯狂不过，但当一家公司处于如此核心的地位时，确实可能发生。” Bubbles are inherently unpredictable: It isn’t clear, ahead of time, what will flip the psychological switch that causes them to burst. The muted market reaction of financial markets to the news on Thursday suggests that investors aren’t losing faith in the A.I. trade. 泡沫本身就难以预测：事先谁也无法确定，究竟什么会触动投资者心理上的开关，导致泡沫破裂。金融市场对周四消息的温和反应表明，投资者并未对人工智能交易失去信心。 But Mr. Klein said the Nvidia mess should be a warning that the complex web of A.I. financing arrangements is threatening financial stability. 但克莱因表示，英伟达的这场风波应该敲响警钟：人工智能产业错综复杂的融资关系正在威胁金融稳定。 “It looks like the financial regulators are sleeping through the alarm clock,” he said. “金融监管机构似乎连闹钟响了都还在睡觉，”他说。 If Nvidia’s new leadership takes a more cautious approach to financing, that could have implications for the broader economy. The data center boom has helped to prop up the construction and manufacturing industries, at a time when tariffs, high interest rates and uncertainty have limited demand from other sectors. 如果英伟达的新管理层在融资方面采取更加谨慎的态度，可能会对整体经济产生影响。在关税、高利率和不确定性抑制其他行业需求之际，数据中心建设热潮一直在支撑建筑业和制造业的发展。 Still, the breakneck pace of the A.I. build-out has also pushed up inflation and raised borrowing costs. Many economists argue that a modest slowdown would be healthy . 不过，人工智能基础设施建设的狂飙突进也推高了通货膨胀和借贷成本。许多经济学家认为， 适度放缓反而有益于经济健康 。 The more immediate risk, economists say, is that a loss of confidence in the A.I. story leads to a steep drop in the stock market. The strength of the market has helped prop up consumer spending even as wage growth has cooled . 经济学家指出，更迫在眉睫的风险是，投资者对人工智能前景失去信心，导致股市大幅下跌。尽管 工资增长已经放缓 ，股市的强劲帮助支撑了消费者支出。 If the A.I. trade unravels because of an abrupt curtailment in investment, “that is more recessionary,” said Pooja Sriram, an economist at Barclays. “That’s when there is a more material shakeout in the stock market that transcends to how consumers feel. Balance sheets are hit and that could escalate very quickly into a downturn.” 巴克莱经济学家普贾·斯里拉姆说，如果人工智能交易因投资突然大幅缩减而瓦解，“那将更容易引发经济衰退”。“届时，股市将出现更为严重的震荡，并进一步影响消费者信心。人们的资产负债状况受到冲击，局面可能迅速恶化，最终演变成经济衰退。” Colby Smith对本文有报道贡献。 Ben Casselman 是《纽约时报》首席经济记者，他从事经济报道近20年。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 关于英伟达临时CEO克雷斯，我们知道些什么
description: ADAM SATARIANO, KALLEY HUANG2026年11月13日英伟达于周四发布首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯的照片。 Nvidia, via Reuters Nvidia said on Thursday that Colette Kress, the company’s chief financial officer, would be the company’s interim chief executive officer, following the resignation of its longtime leader, Jensen Huang, who admitted to an extramarital affair with a businesswoman U.S. intelligence agencies believe to be a spy for China. 英伟达周四表示，在该公司长期领导人黄仁勋辞职后，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯将担任临时首席执行官。黄仁勋承认与一名被美国情报机构认为是中国间谍的女商人有婚外情。 “The board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team,” said Harvey C. Jones, the newly named chair of Nvidia’s board of directors in a statement. “We expect the company’s operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption.” “董事会对科莱特和领导团队充满信心，”新任英伟达董事会主席哈维·C·琼斯在一份声明中表示，“我们预计公司的运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将继续推进，不会中断。” In a note to Nvidia’s employees, Ms. Kress said she believed “deeply in this company” and called its employees “our greatest strength.” She said Nvidia would have a companywide meeting on Nov. 18 to discuss its future. 克雷斯在致英伟达员工的一份备忘录中表示，她“深信这家公司”，并称员工是“我们最大的优势”。她表示，英伟达将于11月18日召开全公司会议，讨论公司未来。 She will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as its interim chief executive officer until the board names a permanent successor. The board said on Thursday that it had started a search for that replacement and would consider internal and external candidates. Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment. 在董事会任命正式继任者之前，她将在担任临时首席执行官的同时继续兼任英伟达首席财务官。董事会周四表示，已开始物色该继任人选，并将考虑内部和外部候选人。英伟达未立即回应置评请求。 Ms. Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013, is leading the company as it enters an uncertain next chapter. Under the leadership of Mr. Huang, Nvidia grew from a niche maker of computer chips used for video games to one of the most valuable public companies in the world and the linchpin of the artificial intelligence boom. Nvidia controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for the chips used in the big A.I. projects that are driving the U.S. economy. 2013年加入英伟达的克雷斯正带领这家公司步入充满不确定性的下一篇章。在黄仁勋的领导下，英伟达从一家生产视频游戏电脑芯片的小众制造商成长为全球市值最高的上市公司之一，以及人工智能热潮的关键支柱。在推动美国经济的大型人工智能项目所使用的芯片市场中，英伟达据估计占据了90%的份额。 Ms. Kress, 59, faces a challenging road. She is temporarily taking over a company that has been tightly controlled by her predecessor. Mr. Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and had managed all aspects of its business with a flat structure that placed him at the center of its day-to-day operations. 现年59岁的克雷斯面临着一条充满挑战的道路。她暂时接管的是一家此前一直由其前任严密掌控的公司。黄仁勋于1993年与人一同创立了英伟达，并通过一种将他置于日常运营核心的扁平化架构管理着公司业务的方方面面。 His family members had steadily risen through its ranks in recent years. And while Ms. Kress is already familiar to Wall Street, she does not have Mr. Huang’s relationships with Nvidia’s sprawling supply chain or Washington. 近年来，他的家庭成员在公司内部稳步晋升。而尽管克雷斯已为华尔街所熟知，她并不具备黄仁勋与英伟达庞大供应链或华盛顿方面建立的关系。 Ms. Kress has a bachelor’s degree in finance from the University of Arizona and a master’s degree in business administration from Southern Methodist University. She previously worked in finance at Texas Instruments, Microsoft and Cisco, before joining Nvidia in 2013. 克雷斯拥有亚利桑那大学金融学学士学位和南卫理公会大学工商管理硕士学位。在2013年加入英伟达之前，她曾在德州仪器、微软和思科从事财务工作。 Mr. Huang interviewed 22 candidates before hiring Ms. Kress as chief financial officer. At the time, Ms. Kress’s young sons, who were avid gamers, encouraged her to join Nvidia. During her first week on the job, Ms. Kress asked Mr. Huang how long he thought he would want her in the role. 在聘请克雷斯担任首席财务官之前，黄仁勋面试了22名候选人。当时，克雷斯的几个年幼的儿子都是狂热的游戏玩家，他们鼓励她加入英伟达。入职第一周，克雷斯曾问黄仁勋，他预计希望她在这个职位上工作多久。 “I said, ‘For as long as we shall live and death do us part,’” Mr. Huang said on a podcast this year. “我说：‘只要我们活着，直到死亡将我们分开，’”黄仁勋今年在一档播客节目中说道。 As chief financial officer, Ms. Kress was responsible for communicating with Nvidia’s investors and Wall Street. Over the past four years, Ms. Kress delivered a rosy message on quarterly earnings calls as Nvidia’s revenue and profits soared, though she also expressed concerns about the financial impact of American policies that restrict the sale of advanced chips to China. 作为首席财务官，克雷斯负责与英伟达投资者和华尔街沟通。过去四年来，随着英伟达营收和利润飙升，克雷斯在季度财报电话会议上一直传递出乐观的信息，不过她也曾对美国限制向中国出售先进芯片的政策所带来的财务影响表示担忧。 In 2013, Nvidia’s revenue was $4.28 billion. Its revenue in its most recent fiscal year was more than 50 times that, at nearly $215.94 billion. In August, Ms. Kress told analysts and investors that Nvidia expects to grow 70 percent next year. 2013年，英伟达的营收为42.8亿美元。该公司最近一个财年的营收是这一数字的50多倍，达到近2159.4亿美元。8月，克雷斯告诉分析师和投资者，英伟达预计明年将增长70%。 Ms. Kress has benefited from Nvidia’s skyrocketing stock price in recent years. As of March, she owned more than 4.4 million shares in the company, according to its most recent annual report, a stake that was worth about $780.4 million at the time. That makes Ms. Kress one of the largest individual shareholders of Nvidia. Its largest individual shareholder, with a 3.56 percent stake, is Mr. Huang. 近年来，克雷斯受益于英伟达飙升的股价。根据该公司最新年报，截至3月，她持有公司超过440万股股票，这些股份当时价值约7.804亿美元。这使克雷斯成为英伟达最大的个人股东之一。该公司最大的个人股东是黄仁勋，持股比例为3.56%。 Ms. Kress’s transition — as well as that of the permanent successor to Mr. Huang — could be complicated by how Mr. Huang managed Nvidia. He led the company with an executive team of more than 60 people who directly reported to him, many of whom are longtime loyalists. That flat structure will be difficult to unwind. On a podcast in January, Mr. Huang described his executive team as a group of “60 people who could be world-class C.E.O.s for many other companies.” 黄仁勋管理英伟达的方式可能会使克雷斯——以及黄仁勋的正式继任者——的过渡变得复杂。他领导公司时拥有一个由60多名直接向他汇报的高管组成的团队，其中许多人是长期追随他的亲信。这种扁平化架构将难以拆解。1月在一档播客节目中，黄仁勋将他的高管团队形容为“60个可以成为其他公司的世界级CEO的人”。 For the time being, Ms. Kress will be C.E.O. for Nvidia. 目前，克雷斯将担任英伟达首席执行官。 Adam Satariano是时报科技记者，常驻伦敦。 Kalley Huang是时报驻旧金山记者，报道苹果公司和科技业新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

Nvidia controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for the chips used in the big A.I. projects that are driving the U.S. economy. 2013年加入英伟达的克雷斯正带领这家公司步入充满不确定性的下一篇章。在黄仁勋的领导下，英伟达从一家生产视频游戏电脑芯片的小众制造商成长为全球市值最高的上市公司之一，以及人工智能热潮的关键支柱。在推动美国经济的大型人工智能项目所使用的芯片市场中，英伟达据估计占据了90%的份额。 Ms. Kress, 59, faces a challenging road. She is temporarily taking over a company that has been tightly controlled by her predecessor. Mr. Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and had managed all aspects of its business with a flat structure that placed him at the center of its day-to-day operations. 现年59岁的克雷斯面临着一条充满挑战的道路。她暂时接管的是一家此前一直由其前任严密掌控的公司。黄仁勋于1993年与人一同创立了英伟达，并通过一种将他置于日常运营核心的扁平化架构管理着公司业务的方方面面。 His family members had steadily risen through its ranks in recent years. And while Ms. Kress is already familiar to Wall Street, she does not have Mr. Huang’s relationships with Nvidia’s sprawling supply chain or Washington. 近年来，他的家庭成员在公司内部稳步晋升。而尽管克雷斯已为华尔街所熟知，她并不具备黄仁勋与英伟达庞大供应链或华盛顿方面建立的关系。 Ms. Kress has a bachelor’s degree in finance from the University of Arizona and a master’s degree in business administration from Southern Methodist University. She previously worked in finance at Texas Instruments, Microsoft and Cisco, before joining Nvidia in 2013. 克雷斯拥有亚利桑那大学金融学学士学位和南卫理公会大学工商管理硕士学位。在2013年加入英伟达之前，她曾在德州仪器、微软和思科从事财务工作。 Mr. Huang interviewed 22 candidates before hiring Ms. Kress as chief financial officer. At the time, Ms. Kress’s young sons, who were avid gamers, encouraged her to join Nvidia. During her first week on the job, Ms. Kress asked Mr. Huang how long he thought he would want her in the role. 在聘请克雷斯担任首席财务官之前，黄仁勋面试了22名候选人。当时，克雷斯的几个年幼的儿子都是狂热的游戏玩家，他们鼓励她加入英伟达。入职第一周，克雷斯曾问黄仁勋，他预计希望她在这个职位上工作多久。 “I said, ‘For as long as we shall live and death do us part,’” Mr. Huang said on a podcast this year. “我说：‘只要我们活着，直到死亡将我们分开，’”黄仁勋今年在一档播客节目中说道。 As chief financial officer, Ms. Kress was responsible for communicating with Nvidia’s investors and Wall Street. Over the past four years, Ms. Kress delivered a rosy message on quarterly earnings calls as Nvidia’s revenue and profits soared, though she also expressed concerns about the financial impact of American policies that restrict the sale of advanced chips to China. 作为首席财务官，克雷斯负责与英伟达投资者和华尔街沟通。过去四年来，随着英伟达营收和利润飙升，克雷斯在季度财报电话会议上一直传递出乐观的信息，不过她也曾对美国限制向中国出售先进芯片的政策所带来的财务影响表示担忧。 In 2013, Nvidia’s revenue was $4.28 billion. Its revenue in its most recent fiscal year was more than 50 times that, at nearly $215.94 billion. In August , Ms. Kress told analysts and investors that Nvidia expects to grow 70 percent next year. 2013年，英伟达的营收为42.8亿美元。该公司最近一个财年的营收是这一数字的50多倍，达到近2159.4亿美元。 8月 ，克雷斯告诉分析师和投资者，英伟达预计明年将增长70%。 Ms. Kress has benefited from Nvidia’s skyrocketing stock price in recent years. As of March, she owned more than 4.4 million shares in the company, according to its most recent annual report, a stake that was worth about $780.4 million at the time. That makes Ms. Kress one of the largest individual shareholders of Nvidia. Its largest individual shareholder, with a 3.56 percent stake, is Mr. Huang. 近年来，克雷斯受益于英伟达飙升的股价。根据该公司最新年报，截至3月，她持有公司超过440万股股票，这些股份当时价值约7.804亿美元。这使克雷斯成为英伟达最大的个人股东之一。该公司最大的个人股东是黄仁勋，持股比例为3.56%。 Ms. Kress’s transition — as well as that of the permanent successor to Mr. Huang — could be complicated by how Mr. Huang managed Nvidia. He led the company with an executive team of more than 60 people who directly reported to him, many of whom are longtime loyalists. That flat structure will be difficult to unwind. On a podcast in January , Mr. Huang described his executive team as a group of “60 people who could be world-class C.E.O.s for many other companies.” 黄仁勋管理英伟达的方式可能会使克雷斯——以及黄仁勋的正式继任者——的过渡变得复杂。他领导公司时拥有一个由60多名直接向他汇报的高管组成的团队，其中许多人是长期追随他的亲信。这种扁平化架构将难以拆解。 1月在一档播客节目中 ，黄仁勋将他的高管团队形容为“60个可以成为其他公司的世界级CEO的人”。 For the time being, Ms. Kress will be C.E.O. for Nvidia. 目前，克雷斯将担任英伟达首席执行官。 Adam Satariano 是时报科技记者，常驻伦敦。 Kalley Huang 是时报驻旧金山记者，报道苹果公司和科技业新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 新加坡政府：在调查黄乐公司时美国几乎未予协助
description: 孟建国2026年11月13日Megaspeed位于新加坡的办公室。该公司由黄乐掌管，她是涉及英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋间谍案的核心人物。 Taryn Ng/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images Singapore’s government said on Thursday the United States had provided little help in its investigation into Alice Huang, the woman at the center of a spy plot that has led to the investigation of Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang. 新加坡政府周四表示，在其针对黄乐(Alice Huang)展开的调查中，美方几乎未提供协助。黄乐是这起间谍案的核心人物，该案已导致英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋受到调查。 Singaporean authorities held Ms. Huang’s passport to prevent her from leaving the country from June 2025 until February over “potential false declarations” in relation to her company, Megaspeed, which is based in the country, the government said in a statement. She was ultimately released with a “stern warning” and barred from re-entering Singapore. 新加坡政府在声明中说，由于黄乐与其在新加坡注册的公司Megaspeed有关的“潜在虚假申报”，新加坡当局从2025年6月起至今年2月扣留了她的护照，以防止她离境。她最终在收到“严厉警告”后被允许离境，并被禁止再次进入新加坡。 The statement raises new questions about the response of the Trump administration to the case and why the U.S. government did not more forcefully intervene. According to the timeline in the statement, Singaporean authorities had been holding Ms. Huang’s passport well after President Trump was briefed last fall about her relationship with Nvidia’s chief executive and the belief that she was a Chinese intelligence asset. 该声明引发了关于特朗普政府对此案反应的新疑问，以及美国政府为何没有更强有力地介入。根据声明中的时间线，在特朗普总统去年秋天听取有关黄乐与英伟达首席执行官关系、以及她被认为是中国情报人员的简报后，新加坡当局仍扣留着她的护照。 The New York Times has reported that Taiwan began monitoring Ms. Huang in 2024 at the guidance of the U.S. government. 《纽约时报》报道，台湾在美国政府指导下，于2024年开始监视黄乐。 In its statement, Singapore said that it had sought information from an American server maker and close Nvidia business partner, Supermicro, but that the company had provided “limited cooperation.” Supermicro, a firm that packages Nvidia’s A.I. chips onto servers that can be used in data centers, has been at the center of a number of chip smuggling investigations across the globe. 新加坡在声明中说，它曾向美国服务器制造商、英伟达紧密的商业伙伴超微电脑寻求信息，该公司仅提供“有限合作”。超微电脑将英伟达的人工智能芯片组装到可用于数据中心的服务器上，一直处于全球多起芯片走私调查的风口浪尖。 Supermicro was a supplier to Megaspeed, a company incorporated in Singapore and run by Ms. Huang, according to two people with knowledge of the matter. 据两名知情人士透露，超微曾是Megaspeed的供应商。Megaspeed在新加坡注册成立，由黄乐经营。 Singapore said in the statement its authorities raised Supermicro’s “limited cooperation” with the U.S. Department of Justice and Federal Bureau of Investigation in July 2025 and “requested their assistance in securing the company’s cooperation.” 新加坡在声明中说，当局于2025年7月向美国司法部和联邦调查局提出了超微电脑“合作有限”的问题，并“请求他们协助确保该公司合作”。 “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company,” the statement said. “尽管多次提出请求，新加坡迄今在有关该公司的问题上获得的信息或协助有限，”声明说。 Supermicro denied that Megaspeed had ever been a customer. “Supermicro did not sell any products to Megaspeed and has operated in compliance with all applicable U.S. export and re-export control laws,” the company said in a statement. 超微电脑否认Megaspeed曾是它的客户。“超微电脑没有向Megaspeed出售任何产品，并且一直遵守所有适用的美国出口和再出口管制法律，”该公司在一份声明中说。 During questioning, Ms. Huang sought to downplay her role in Megaspeed, according to Singapore’s statement. She was ultimately released because of “insufficient evidence relating to the possible inaccurate declarations for which Megaspeed was being investigated.” 根据新加坡的声明，在接受讯问时，黄乐试图淡化自己在Megaspeed的角色。她最终获释，原因是“关于Megaspeed公司正在接受调查的可能存在不实申报一事证据不足”。 She was issued a “stern warning” and barred from re-entering Singapore. The country’s police are continuing to investigate Megaspeed. 她收到“严厉警告”，并被禁止再次进入新加坡。该国警方仍在继续调查Megaspeed公司。 孟建国(Paul Mozur)是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: “美人计”：中国间谍机构如何利用亲密关系套取情报
description: 郭莉莉2026年11月13日2024年，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与黄乐在台湾台北。美国官员表示，一个间谍机构招募了她，以收集有关黄仁勋的情报。 Obtained By Reuters At the height of the Cold War, a top official in China’s intelligence agency said that his country would never use seduction to entrap a person. 在冷战正酣之时，中国情报机构的一名高官曾表示，中国绝不会利用美色给人设圈套。 Such tactics might be for the C.I.A. or the K.G.B., the official named Kong Yuan, of the Central Investigation Department, told a group of agents in training in April 1960, but China was guided by principles. He looked at the few female comrades in the audience. “Rest assured, we will not be asking you to go run beauty traps.” 1960年4月，这位名叫孔原的中央调查部官员在对一批受训特工讲话时表示，此类策略也许是中央情报局或克格勃的作风，但中国做事是讲原则的。他看着台下为数不多的女同志说：“放心，我们不会要求你们去施美人计。” Despite that pledge, captured in a 2010 memoir by a former Chinese diplomat, China’s intelligence services have for decades used romantic entanglements to compromise or extract information from prominent people. 尽管一名前中国外交官在2010年的回忆录中记录了这一保证，但数十年来，中国情报部门一直利用浪漫纠葛来牵制知名人士，或从中套取信息。 American officials say that China’s Ministry of State Security, which runs intelligence operations today, recruited a Chinese businesswoman to collect intelligence on Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia and one of the most powerful figures in the artificial intelligence boom. 美国官员表示，目前负责情报行动的中国国家安全部招募了一名中国女商人，以收集有关英伟达首席执行官、人工智能热潮中最具权力的人物之一黄仁勋的情报。 It was not clear what role the woman, Alice Huang, or Huang Le, might have had with the Chinese spy agency. Ms. Huang was a top executive of a Singapore company that operates data centers in Southeast Asia using Nvidia chips and that rents their computing power to Chinese firms. 目前尚不清楚这位名为Alice Huang或黄乐的女子与中国间谍机构有何种关系。她是一家新加坡企业的高管，该公司在东南亚使用英伟达芯片运营数据中心，并将其算力出租给中国公司。 Mr. Huang has acknowledged that he had an affair with Ms. Huang. President Trump has said that Mr. Huang told him that he was not aware that the woman was a spy. China has rejected the espionage allegations against Ms. Huang, calling them smears against the country. U.S. officials have not provided evidence for their claims. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. 黄仁勋已承认他与黄乐有染。特朗普总统曾表示，黄仁勋告诉他自己并不知道该女子是间谍。中国否认了黄乐为间谍的指控，称这是对中国的抹黑。美国官员并未提供支持其主张的证据。黄乐未对置评请求作出回应。 The use of relationships or seduction in the world of espionage is not new or unique to China. The tactic was made infamous by East Germany’s “Romeos,” male Stasi agents tasked with seducing the clerks of Western officials, and by the Soviet Union’s longtime use of sexual blackmail, among other examples. 在间谍领域，利用人际关系或美色并非新鲜事，也非中国独有。这一策略因东德的“罗密欧”（奉命诱惑西方官员身边职员的男性斯塔西特工）以及苏联长期以使用性勒索而闻名。 What is unique about China’s use of the tactic is the amount of time invested, according to Nicholas Eftimiades, a retired senior American intelligence officer who writes about China’s espionage operations. 撰写过关于中国间谍行动文章的退休美国高级情报官员尼古拉斯·埃夫蒂米亚德斯表示，中国使用这一策略的独特之处在于其投入的时间。 “They play this long term,” he said. “These are long-term relationships, sometimes marriages.” “他们放长线，”他说。“这些是长期的关系，有时甚至是婚姻。” Perhaps the most famous example involves Shi Peipu, a Peking Opera singer whose two-decade relationship with Bernard Boursicot, who worked on French diplomatic missions in Beijing and Ulan Bator in Mongolia, drew Mr. Boursicot into spying for China. Both were arrested in France, at which point Mr. Boursicot learned that his lover was a man. In 1986, they were convicted of espionage. Their story inspired the play “M. Butterfly” by David Henry Hwang. 也许最著名的例子是京剧演员时佩璞。他与曾在法国驻北京和蒙古乌兰巴托外交使团工作的伯纳德·布尔西科维持了二十年的关系，使布尔西科开始为中国从事间谍活动。两人在法国被捕，此时布尔西科才得知他的情人是一名男性。1986年，他们被判犯有间谍罪。他们的故事启发了黄哲伦(David Henry Hwang)创作的戏剧《蝴蝶君》(M. Butterfly)。 曾任法国驻北京大使馆雇员的伯纳德·布尔西科于1986年被判间谍罪名成立。 More recent cases include Christine Fang, or Fang Fang, who was believed by counterintelligence officials to be a Chinese spy and who was in a physical relationship with former U.S. Representative Eric Swalwell between 2012 and 2015. 更近期的案例包括方芳(Christine Fang)，她被反间谍官员认为是一名中国间谍，并在2012年至2015年间与前联邦众议员埃里克·斯沃韦尔发生了性关系。 Separately, a retired U.S. Army officer who was working as a contractor for the U.S. Pacific Command in Hawaii was sentenced to prison in 2014 for emailing defense secrets, including details about joint training exercises between the United States and South Korea, to a 27-year-old Chinese woman with whom he had been involved romantically for almost two years. 另一起案件中，一名曾在夏威夷担任美国太平洋司令部承包商的陆军退役军官于2014年被判处入狱，罪名是向一名27岁的中国女子发送包括美韩联合军事演习细节在内的国防机密。他与该女子保持了近两年的恋爱关系。 In 2003, an F.B.I. agent, James J. Smith, who worked in Chinese counterintelligence, admitted that he had an affair for nearly 20 years with a Chinese American businesswoman suspected of being a Chinese double agent. The woman, whom he had recruited as an asset, was found to have given classified U.S. government information to Beijing. 2003年，从事中国反间谍工作的联邦调查局特工詹姆斯·J·史密斯承认，他与一名被怀疑是中美双重间谍的华裔美国女商人有近20年的婚外情。这名被他招募为线人的女子被发现向北京提供了美国政府机密信息。 Both the United States and China appear to be concerned about the possibility of emotional or other manipulation by the other side. Last year, the U.S. government prohibited American personnel in China from having romantic or sexual relationships with Chinese citizens, according to The Associated Press. 美国和中国似乎都对遭到对方情感或其他操纵的可能性感到担忧。据美联社报道，去年，美国政府禁止在华的美国人员与中国公民建立感情或性关系。 China’s intelligence agency itself frequently warns its citizens to look out for foreign operatives attempting to trap them. In May, China’s Ministry of State Security published an article on WeChat that called on residents to “be wary of sudden advances and overt displays of affection from seemingly perfect individuals of the opposite sex.” 中国情报机构本身也经常警告其公民提防试图诱惑他们的外国特工。今年5月，中国国家安全部在微信上发表了一篇文章，呼吁民众警惕“‘完美异性’的突然靠近与主动示好”。 “Avoid falling into the ‘gentle trap,’” it said. “避免陷入‘温柔陷阱’，”文章称。 2003年，退休联邦调查局特工詹姆斯·J·史密斯离开洛杉矶一家联邦法院。他承认曾与一名被怀疑是中美双重间谍的华裔美国女商人保持了近20年的婚外情。 Alex Joske, managing director at Garnaut Global, an advisory firm, said the Chinese ministry’s warnings about espionage “are usually based on the kinds of things that they do rather than what other countries actually do.” 咨询公司加诺特全球的常务董事周安澜(Alex Joske)表示，中国安全部门关于间谍活动的警告“通常是基于他们自己所做的事情，而不是其他国家实际做的事情”。 Compared with Western intelligence agencies, the Chinese government is more willing to use blackmail and coercion in its operations, including romance and sexual activities, he argued. Western governments see blackmail as a less reliable way of motivating a source or asset, he said. 他认为，与西方情报机构相比，中国政府在其行动中更愿意使用勒索和胁迫手段，包括恋爱和性活动。他说，西方政府认为勒索是一种不太可靠的驱动线人或情报资产的方式。 China’s Ministry of State Security, which oversees operations abroad as well as security within the country, is known for its highly coercive methods that include threats of arrest and detention. 负责海外行动和国内安全的中国国家安全部以使用包括威胁拘捕在内的高压手段而闻名。 The agency also exploits other forms of relationships, like family ties. A former F.B.I. agent in New York was recruited, with the help of his mother in China, to pass information about the agency to Beijing. He pleaded guilty to the charges in 2016. 该机构还利用其他形式的关系，如家庭纽带。纽约的一名前联邦调查局特工在其身在中国的母亲的帮助下被招募，向北京传递有关该机构的信息。他于2016年认罪。 China does engage in the kind of sexually baited entrapment one might see in a spy drama, according to former American intelligence officers. “A diplomat walks into his hotel room, and there’s a girl in his bed. I mean, that stuff happens. It’s just kind of ridiculous,” Mr. Eftimiades said. 前美国情报官员表示，中国确实会使用那种在间谍剧中能看到的色诱圈套。“一名外交官走进他的酒店房间，床上躺着一个女孩。我是说，这种事情确实发生过。这简直有些荒谬，”埃夫蒂米亚德斯说。 Dennis Wilder, who was senior China director at the National Security Council during the George W. Bush administration and a former senior intelligence officer, describes how when he traveled to Beijing, a woman would often be waiting in the elevator for him when he returned to his hotel. 曾在乔治·W·布什政府担任国家安全委员会中国事务高级主任的前高级情报官员韦德宁(Dennis Wilder)描述了当他前往北京时，一名女子经常会在他回到酒店时在电梯里等他。 “She’d say, ‘You know, I can come to your room.’ And I’d say, ‘Well why do you want to come to my room?’ And they did this over and over again to see if they could get me,” he said, noting that if he was ever to publicly accuse the Chinese of trying to entrap him, they could say the women were prostitutes working on their own volition. “她会说，‘你知道，我可以去你的房间。’我会说，‘那么你为什么想去我的房间？’他们一遍又一遍地这样做，看看能否钓到我，”他说。他指出，如果他公开指责中国试图色诱他，他们可以说这些女子是自愿从事卖淫活动的。 “That’s the beauty of this kind of thing. It’s totally deniable,” Mr. Wilder said. “这种事情妙就妙在这里。完全可以否认，”韦德宁说。 But more often than not, Mr. Eftimiades said, Beijing is not sending operatives to stage romantic encounters for blackmail. Instead, it looks for people whose personal or professional lives give them access to potential targets, he said. 但埃夫蒂米亚德斯说，多数情况下，北京并不是派特工去安排浪漫邂逅进行勒索。相反，它寻找的是那些个人或职业生活能让他们接触到潜在目标的人。 Many details of the relationship between Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang, including when they met and under what circumstances Ms. Huang may have begun gathering information for Beijing, remain unclear. 关于黄仁勋与黄乐关系的许多细节目前都尚不明确，包括他们何时相识，以及她可能在何种情况下开始为北京收集信息。 中天节目画面显示，2025年黄乐在台北一家餐厅与黄仁勋共进晚餐。 China’s large diaspora includes executives, students and others who can be recruited in what Mr. Eftimiades calls the country’s “whole of society” approach to espionage. 中国庞大的海外华人群体涵盖企业高管、学生及其他人员，在埃夫蒂米亚德斯所称的中国“全社会”间谍模式下，他们都可能成为招募对象。 Of the many cases of Chinese spying that have come to light over the past few years, only a handful involve romantic relationships. In most cases, the best motivation is money, Mr. Joske says. But when it comes to targeting wealthy elites, money is not always as powerful a recruitment tool. 过去几年曝光的众多中国间谍案中，仅有少数涉及感情关系。周安澜表示，多数案件中最有效的动机是金钱。但针对富有的精英时，金钱并非总是如此有效的招募工具。 “So instead, you try to co-opt someone in their circle,” he said. That includes someone with whom that person has a close relationship. “因此，取而代之的做法是试图拉拢其圈子里的人，”他说。这包括与目标人物关系密切的人。 A close relationship is also conducive to another major goal of China’s intelligence operations, which is to exert influence on key decision makers or gather information to sway other prominent figures to support policies favorable to Beijing. 密切关系还有助于实现中国情报行动的另一主要目标，即对关键决策者施加影响，或收集情报以促使其他知名人士支持对北京有利的政策。 “Once you become emotionally involved with somebody, your base line judgment changes,” said Matthew Brazil, a senior fellow at The Jamestown Foundation focusing on Chinese intelligence operations. “People want to please their lovers.” “一旦你对某人投入感情，你的基本判断力就会改变，”专注于中国情报行动研究的詹姆斯敦基金会高级研究员马修·布拉齐尔说。“人们都想取悦自己的恋人。” David Pierson自香港、Pei-Lin Wu自台北对本文有报道贡献。 郭莉莉(Lily Kuo)是《纽约时报》报道中国记者，常驻台北。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

That includes someone with whom that person has a close relationship. “因此，取而代之的做法是试图拉拢其圈子里的人，”他说。这包括与目标人物关系密切的人。 A close relationship is also conducive to another major goal of China’s intelligence operations, which is to exert influence on key decision makers or gather information to sway other prominent figures to support policies favorable to Beijing. 密切关系还有助于实现中国情报行动的另一主要目标，即对关键决策者施加影响，或收集情报以促使其他知名人士支持对北京有利的政策。 “Once you become emotionally involved with somebody, your base line judgment changes,” said Matthew Brazil, a senior fellow at The Jamestown Foundation focusing on Chinese intelligence operations. “People want to please their lovers.” “一旦你对某人投入感情，你的基本判断力就会改变，”专注于中国情报行动研究的詹姆斯敦基金会高级研究员马修·布拉齐尔说。“人们都想取悦自己的恋人。” David Pierson自香港、Pei-Lin Wu自台北对本文有报道贡献。 郭莉莉( Lily Kuo )是《纽约时报》报道中国记者，常驻台北。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，公司首席财务官克雷斯临时接任
description: TRIPP MICKLE, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月13日在硅谷，很少有高管像英伟达联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋那样，与自己所在的公司如此密不可分。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times Jensen Huang, the co-founder and chief executive of the Silicon Valley chip giant Nvidia, resigned on Thursday, according to the company’s board of directors, capping a swift, stunning fall of one of the most powerful figures in the A.I. boom. His departure came after revelations that he had extramarital affairs with an executive who reported to him and with a woman whom U.S. intelligence agencies concluded was spying for China. 据英伟达董事会消息，这家硅谷芯片巨头的联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于周四辞职。黄仁勋是人工智能热潮中最具影响力的人物之一，这一消息为其在英伟达的职业生涯画上了骤然且令人震惊的句号。此前他被披露与一名向其汇报工作的公司高管以及一名被美国情报机构认定为中国间谍的女性有婚外情。 President Trump, who had defended Mr. Huang over the past week, praised him for doing a “fantastic job” atop the Nvidia, which entered a moment of uncertainty without the celebrity C.E.O. whose departure immediately reverberated through the global economy. 美国总统特朗普过去一周以来一直为黄仁勋辩护，他称赞黄仁勋在执掌英伟达期间“干得非常出色”。随着这位明星首席执行官的离任，英伟达步入了一个充满不确定性的时期，他的离任也立即在全球经济中引发震动。 Colette Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer, will serve as interim chief executive while the search for a permanent replacement is carried out, Nvidia’s 10-member board said in a statement. 英伟达由10名成员组成的董事会在一份声明中表示，在寻找永久继任者期间，公司首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯将担任临时首席执行官。 Nvidia controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for the advanced chips that are an essential component of artificial intelligence projects. Mr. Huang’s exit, which followed a lengthy board meeting on Wednesday, will have widespread ripple effects. Shares of Nvidia, one of the world’s most valuable public companies, plunged at the start of trading, weighing on the broader market. 英伟达控制着人工智能项目核心组件——高端芯片约90%的市场份额。黄仁勋在周三一场漫长的董事会会议后决定离职，此举将产生广泛的连锁反应。作为全球市值最高的上市公司之一，英伟达股价在开盘时大幅下跌，拖累了整个大盘走势。 Nvidia, long a maker of graphics chips, became a linchpin of A.I. development in recent years, which put it at the center of the U.S.-China tussle for dominance in the sector. 长期以来以制造图形处理芯片闻名的英伟达近年来已成为人工智能发展的中流砥柱，这也使其处于中美两国争夺该领域主导权的漩涡中心。 A series of reports by The New York Times showed that Mr. Huang, 63, had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman who goes by Alice Huang, who had been recruited by China’s main spy agency to gather information on Mr. Huang. The Times also reported that Mr. Trump had been warned about the relationship but took no action. 《纽约时报》的一系列报道显示，现年63岁的黄仁勋曾与一位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女商人有染，该女子已被中国主要情报机构招募，负责收集有关黄仁勋的情报。《纽约时报》还报道称，特朗普此前曾收到过关于这段关系的警告，但并未采取任何行动。 U.S. officials suspect that Megaspeed, the Singaporean company where Ms. Huang was a top executive, has helped smuggle restricted chips into China. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment, and China has rejected the espionage claims and called the smuggling allegations “smears.” 美国官员怀疑，黄乐担任高管的新加坡公司Megaspeed曾协助向中国走私受限制的芯片。黄乐未回应置评请求，而中国否认了间谍指控，并称走私芯片的指责是“抹黑”。 Nvidia’s board, which has had a long track record of deference to its chief executive, did not mention Mr. Huang’s conduct in its statement. It called his contributions to Nvidia “profound” and thanked him for his “immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry.” 长期以来对首席执行官颇为顺从的英伟达董事会在声明中并未提及黄仁勋的行为。董事会称他对英伟达的贡献“影响深远”，并感谢他为“公司和整个行业作出的不可估量的贡献”。 While the board begins its search for the company’s next leader, Mr. Trump had his own idea: Tim Cook, the former chief executive of Apple. “A Legend replaces a Legend!” he wrote on social media. 在董事会开始物色公司下一任掌门人之际，特朗普提出了自己的想法：苹果公司前首席执行官蒂姆·库克。他在社交媒体上写道：“一位传奇接替另一位传奇！” 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 黄仁勋令皮夹克爱好者蒙羞
description: ANAND GIRIDHARADAS2026年11月12日 It has been a hard week, even for the thick-skinned. 这一周过得可真不容易，哪怕对那些脸皮厚的人来说也是如此。 The news that Jensen Huang, a co-founder of Nvidia, admitted to an affair with a woman whom U.S. intelligence regards as a Chinese spy, has shaken not only Silicon Valley and geopolitics. It also has been an earthquake for the leather-jacket-wearing community. 英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋承认与一名被美国情报机构视为中国间谍的女子发生婚外情，这一消息不仅震动了硅谷和地缘政治，对我们这些皮夹克爱好者来说也无异于一场地震。 We ask ourselves: Was Mr. Huang an easy mark because of his love of high-fashion, motorcycle-adjacent jackets that say both “I don’t care what people think!” and “Do you like how I look?” Did our — I mean, his — armor make him a target? Is an expensive leather jacket on a middle-aged man the new symbol of a honeypot victim? 我们不禁自问：黄仁勋是不是因为迷恋那些出自高端时装品牌、带有摩托车骑士风格的皮夹克，才那么容易上钩的？这些夹克仿佛一边宣称“我才不在乎别人怎么看我”，一边又在问“你觉得我这样穿好看吗”。我们——不对，是他——身上的这层盔甲是否反而让他成了猎物？昂贵的皮夹克难道如今成了中年男人落入美人计圈套的标志？ Without any authorization whatsoever, because that would go against our rebellious grain, I’m speaking out on behalf of the leather-jacket community. We are washed-up musicians and we are dads just trying to feel something again and we are people who want others to assume that we own a Ducati Panigale. And we are here to defend the leather jacket’s name and honor. 我并未得到任何人的授权——毕竟征求授权有违我们骨子里的叛逆精神，但我还是要代表皮夹克爱好者群体站出来说几句。我们当中有过气的音乐人，有试图重新找回一点激情的父亲，也有希望别人以为自己拥有一辆杜卡迪Panigale摩托车的人。今天，我们要捍卫皮夹克的名声与荣誉。 We declare: One man’s fleshly failures should not impugn our second skins. They say not to throw out the baby with the bathwater. Well, similarly, don’t throw out the baby lambskin with the horny human body beneath. 我们宣布：一个男人的肉体过失不应玷污我们的第二层皮肤。俗话说，倒洗澡水时别把孩子一起倒掉。那么同样，也别因为小羊皮夹克下面春心荡漾的肉体就连无辜的小羊皮也一并抛弃。 For many of us, this crisis began long before my fellow graying middle-aged man fell for the oldest trick in the spy book. It began when Mr. Huang had the chutzpah to appropriate our big thing as his big thing. A tech tycoon in his soon-to-be-signature Tom Ford leather jacket was just what we were hoping the rest of the world didn’t see when it looked at us. 对我们许多人来说，这场危机早在那位同样头发花白的中年男子中了间谍套路中最古老的圈套之前就开始了。真正的问题始于黄仁勋竟然厚着脸皮把我们引以为傲的标志性装束变成了他自己的招牌。一个科技大亨穿着后来成为其标志性装扮的汤姆·福特皮夹克——这恰恰是我们最不希望别人看到我们时联想到的形象。 Even then, were we aware that we had a problem? Sure. We may have undiagnosed issues with vulnerability (as reflected in our need for a supplemental dermis), but we’re not stupid. Did we acquire multiple jackets that our spouses smeared as “identical to the last one”? Yes. But a lot of our spouses don’t know the difference between a 1.5-ounce leather and a three-ounce leather, which is like not knowing the difference between Texas and cheese. This was our thing, OK? 我们当时是否意识到问题的存在？当然。我们或许在如何袒露脆弱的一面上有些尚未确诊的心理问题——否则何必给自己再添一层皮肤呢——但我们又不傻。我们是不是买过好几件被配偶讥讽为“跟上一件一模一样”的夹克？没错。但我们的许多配偶根本分不清1.5盎司重的皮革和3盎司重的皮革有什么区别。就像分不清德克萨斯和奶酪的区别一样。拜托，这可是我们自己的爱好，好吗？ Then Mr. Huang, with his own penchant for black leather jackets, had to go and become a household name, the pillar of artificial intelligence, and the man, we were told, without whom the future itself might vanish and the world regress to however it got things done in 2022. 偏偏黄仁勋也喜欢黑色皮夹克，而且非要成为家喻户晓的人物、人工智能产业的支柱。我们还被告知，没有他，未来本身都可能不复存在，世界将倒退到2022年那种不知道靠什么办法做事的年代。 It was annoying to watch a billionaire cosplaying as a rebel, perhaps in order to mask his extraordinary power. Here he was boasting in interviews of not even knowing where his jackets came from, saying his wife and daughter bought them for him, when we in the community could tell you what we ate for dinner any of those fateful days when a new jacket came into our lives. Leather jackets are for people with chips on their shoulders, not microchips in their palms. 看着一个亿万富豪装扮成叛逆者，实在让人恼火。他或许是想借此掩饰自己非同寻常的权力。他还在采访中炫耀，说自己甚至不知道身上的夹克是从哪里买来的，都是妻子和女儿替他购置的。可我们这些真正的皮夹克爱好者，连每一件新夹克来到自己生命中的那个重要日子晚餐吃了什么都记得清清楚楚。皮夹克是给那些心里憋着一股不服气的人穿的，而不是给手握微芯片的人穿的。 People did begin to ask me, a longtime aficionado, if I was emulating Mr. Huang. How dare they! Is it not enough for Mr. Huang to facilitate taking away all the jobs? He wants all the animal skins, too! We in the community began to long for the days when a group of people in leather jackets was called a posse. Now it is known as an A.I. panel. 渐渐地，竟然有人开始问我这个多年的皮夹克爱好者是不是在模仿黄仁勋。他们怎么敢！黄仁勋帮着让人工智能抢走大家的工作还不够，难道连所有动物的皮都想据为己有？我们这些皮夹克爱好者开始怀念从前的日子，那时候，一群穿着皮夹克的人聚在一起叫作一帮硬汉。如今，这种场面却成了人工智能论坛。 At the same time, I identified with some of his comments about the leather lifestyle. These jackets are indeed a great uniform for people who don’t want to think about what to wear every day. They curb the problem of choice even if they signal that you are a problem. And when you belong to a minority group in America, having a signature look is a great way not to be confused with Vivek Ramaswamy. 同时，我认同他关于皮夹克生活方式的一些说法。这些夹克确实是那些不想每天思考穿什么的人的绝佳制服。皮夹克解决了穿什么的难题，却也可能让别人觉得你本人就是个麻烦。而当你在美国属于少数群体时，有一个标志性造型是避免被误认为维韦克·拉马斯瓦米（印度裔美国企业家，共和党政治人物——译注）的好办法。 Then the espionage scandal erupted, and our community of middle-aged leathermen was forced into a reckoning. Are we not as tough as we look? Does the world see us in our skins and think: That guy is one flirty, age-gapped compliment about his panel performance away from potentially divulging secrets? 然后间谍丑闻爆发了，我们这个中年皮夹克群体被迫反思。难道我们并不像外表看起来那么强悍？世人看到我们穿着皮夹克，会不会心想：这家伙只要被一个年轻不少的人暧昧地恭维一句“你在论坛上的表现真棒”，就可能把秘密都抖出来？ The Chinese did not, as far as we know, pursue Mark Zuckerberg, with his T-shirts that look as if they were acquired at the estate sale of someone for whom Ozempic worked a little too well. They did not go after Sam Altman’s hoodies. If there was a target on Mr. Huang’s back, it was made from a buttery, buttery leather. 据我们所知，中国人没有盯上马克·扎克伯格。看看他那些T恤吧，简直像是从某个使用减肥药司美格鲁肽的效果好得过了头的人旧物拍卖会上淘来的。他们也没有盯上萨姆·奥尔特曼的连帽衫。如果黄仁勋背上真有一个靶心，那一定是用柔软得不能再柔软的皮革做成的。 Those of us in the midlife leather-clad community must face what T.S. Eliot called an “overwhelming question”: Do we accessory pivot? Cede the leather jacket to a delusional man trying desperately to look young? Or do we insist that we were that man long before him? 我们这些中年皮夹克爱好者必须面对T·S·艾略特所说的“压倒一切的问题”：我们是不是该换个配饰，另立风格？把皮夹克拱手让给一个不顾一切想显得年轻、却有些自欺欺人的男人？还是坚持说，早在他之前，我们就已经是这种人了？ Anand Giridharadas是《镜中人：美国城市的希望、奋斗与归属感》一书的作者，也是新闻通讯The Ink的出版人。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

It also has been an earthquake for the leather-jacket-wearing community. 英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋承认与一名被美国情报机构视为中国间谍的女子发生婚外情，这一消息不仅震动了硅谷和地缘政治，对我们这些皮夹克爱好者来说也无异于一场地震。 We ask ourselves: Was Mr. Huang an easy mark because of his love of high-fashion, motorcycle-adjacent jackets that say both “I don’t care what people think!” and “Do you like how I look?” Did our — I mean, his — armor make him a target? Is an expensive leather jacket on a middle-aged man the new symbol of a honeypot victim? 我们不禁自问：黄仁勋是不是因为迷恋那些出自高端时装品牌、带有摩托车骑士风格的皮夹克，才那么容易上钩的？这些夹克仿佛一边宣称“我才不在乎别人怎么看我”，一边又在问“你觉得我这样穿好看吗”。我们——不对，是他——身上的这层盔甲是否反而让他成了猎物？昂贵的皮夹克难道如今成了中年男人落入美人计圈套的标志？ Without any authorization whatsoever, because that would go against our rebellious grain, I’m speaking out on behalf of the leather-jacket community. We are washed-up musicians and we are dads just trying to feel something again and we are people who want others to assume that we own a Ducati Panigale. And we are here to defend the leather jacket’s name and honor. 我并未得到任何人的授权——毕竟征求授权有违我们骨子里的叛逆精神，但我还是要代表皮夹克爱好者群体站出来说几句。我们当中有过气的音乐人，有试图重新找回一点激情的父亲，也有希望别人以为自己拥有一辆杜卡迪Panigale摩托车的人。今天，我们要捍卫皮夹克的名声与荣誉。 We declare: One man’s fleshly failures should not impugn our second skins. They say not to throw out the baby with the bathwater. Well, similarly, don’t throw out the baby lambskin with the horny human body beneath. 我们宣布：一个男人的肉体过失不应玷污我们的第二层皮肤。俗话说，倒洗澡水时别把孩子一起倒掉。那么同样，也别因为小羊皮夹克下面春心荡漾的肉体就连无辜的小羊皮也一并抛弃。 For many of us, this crisis began long before my fellow graying middle-aged man fell for the oldest trick in the spy book. It began when Mr. Huang had the chutzpah to appropriate our big thing as his big thing. A tech tycoon in his soon-to-be-signature Tom Ford leather jacket was just what we were hoping the rest of the world didn’t see when it looked at us. 对我们许多人来说，这场危机早在那位同样头发花白的中年男子中了间谍套路中最古老的圈套之前就开始了。真正的问题始于黄仁勋竟然厚着脸皮把我们引以为傲的标志性装束变成了他自己的招牌。一个科技大亨穿着后来成为其标志性装扮的汤姆·福特皮夹克——这恰恰是我们最不希望别人看到我们时联想到的形象。 Even then, were we aware that we had a problem? Sure. We may have undiagnosed issues with vulnerability (as reflected in our need for a supplemental dermis), but we’re not stupid. Did we acquire multiple jackets that our spouses smeared as “identical to the last one”? Yes. But a lot of our spouses don’t know the difference between a 1.5-ounce leather and a three-ounce leather, which is like not knowing the difference between Texas and cheese. This was our thing, OK? 我们当时是否意识到问题的存在？当然。我们或许在如何袒露脆弱的一面上有些尚未确诊的心理问题——否则何必给自己再添一层皮肤呢——但我们又不傻。我们是不是买过好几件被配偶讥讽为“跟上一件一模一样”的夹克？没错。但我们的许多配偶根本分不清1.5盎司重的皮革和3盎司重的皮革有什么区别。就像分不清德克萨斯和奶酪的区别一样。拜托，这可是我们自己的爱好，好吗？ Then Mr. Huang, with his own penchant for black leather jackets, had to go and become a household name, the pillar of artificial intelligence, and the man, we were told, without whom the future itself might vanish and the world regress to however it got things done in 2022. 偏偏黄仁勋也喜欢黑色皮夹克，而且非要成为家喻户晓的人物、人工智能产业的支柱。我们还被告知，没有他，未来本身都可能不复存在，世界将倒退到2022年那种不知道靠什么办法做事的年代。 It was annoying to watch a billionaire cosplaying as a rebel, perhaps in order to mask his extraordinary power. Here he was boasting in interviews of not even knowing where his jackets came from, saying his wife and daughter bought them for him, when we in the community could tell you what we ate for dinner any of those fateful days when a new jacket came into our lives. Leather jackets are for people with chips on their shoulders, not microchips in their palms. 看着一个亿万富豪装扮成叛逆者，实在让人恼火。他或许是想借此掩饰自己非同寻常的权力。他还在采访中炫耀，说自己甚至不知道身上的夹克是从哪里买来的，都是妻子和女儿替他购置的。可我们这些真正的皮夹克爱好者，连每一件新夹克来到自己生命中的那个重要日子晚餐吃了什么都记得清清楚楚。皮夹克是给那些心里憋着一股不服气的人穿的，而不是给手握微芯片的人穿的。 People did begin to ask me, a longtime aficionado, if I was emulating Mr. Huang. How dare they! Is it not enough for Mr. Huang to facilitate taking away all the jobs? He wants all the animal skins, too! We in the community began to long for the days when a group of people in leather jackets was called a posse. Now it is known as an A.I. panel. 渐渐地，竟然有人开始问我这个多年的皮夹克爱好者是不是在模仿黄仁勋。他们怎么敢！黄仁勋帮着让人工智能抢走大家的工作还不够，难道连所有动物的皮都想据为己有？我们这些皮夹克爱好者开始怀念从前的日子，那时候，一群穿着皮夹克的人聚在一起叫作一帮硬汉。如今，这种场面却成了人工智能论坛。 At the same time, I identified with some of his comments about the leather lifestyle. These jackets are indeed a great uniform for people who don’t want to think about what to wear every day. They curb the problem of choice even if they signal that you are a problem. And when you belong to a minority group in America, having a signature look is a great way not to be confused with Vivek Ramaswamy. 同时，我认同他关于皮夹克生活方式的一些说法。这些夹克确实是那些不想每天思考穿什么的人的绝佳制服。皮夹克解决了穿什么的难题，却也可能让别人觉得你本人就是个麻烦。而当你在美国属于少数群体时，有一个标志性造型是避免被误认为维韦克·拉马斯瓦米（印度裔美国企业家，共和党政治人物——译注）的好办法。 Then the espionage scandal erupted, and our community of middle-aged leathermen was forced into a reckoning. Are we not as tough as we look? Does the world see us in our skins and think: That guy is one flirty, age-gapped compliment about his panel performance away from potentially divulging secrets? 然后间谍丑闻爆发了，我们这个中年皮夹克群体被迫反思。难道我们并不像外表看起来那么强悍？世人看到我们穿着皮夹克，会不会心想：这家伙只要被一个年轻不少的人暧昧地恭维一句“你在论坛上的表现真棒”，就可能把秘密都抖出来？ The Chinese did not, as far as we know, pursue Mark Zuckerberg, with his T-shirts that look as if they were acquired at the estate sale of someone for whom Ozempic worked a little too well. They did not go after Sam Altman’s hoodies. If there was a target on Mr. Huang’s back, it was made from a buttery, buttery leather. 据我们所知，中国人没有盯上马克·扎克伯格。看看他那些T恤吧，简直像是从某个使用减肥药司美格鲁肽的效果好得过了头的人旧物拍卖会上淘来的。他们也没有盯上萨姆·奥尔特曼的连帽衫。如果黄仁勋背上真有一个靶心，那一定是用柔软得不能再柔软的皮革做成的。 Those of us in the midlife leather-clad community must face what T.S. Eliot called an “overwhelming question”: Do we accessory pivot? Cede the leather jacket to a delusional man trying desperately to look young? Or do we insist that we were that man long before him? 我们这些中年皮夹克爱好者必须面对T·S·艾略特所说的“压倒一切的问题”：我们是不是该换个配饰，另立风格？把皮夹克拱手让给一个不顾一切想显得年轻、却有些自欺欺人的男人？还是坚持说，早在他之前，我们就已经是这种人了？ Anand Giridharadas是 《镜中人：美国城市的希望、奋斗与归属感》 一书的作者，也是新闻通讯The Ink的出版人。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 黄仁勋事件折射中美外交背后的激烈情报战
description: DAVID PIERSON2026年11月12日9月，在白宫举行的国宴上，特朗普总统（左）和黄仁勋（右）聆听中国国家主席习近平的讲话。 Doug Mills/The New York Times As President Trump and China’s leader, Xi Jinping, prepare to meet next week to extend a fragile trade truce, a fresh espionage scandal has shown that behind their diplomacy is a fierce intelligence rivalry. 就在特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平准备下周会面以延长脆弱的贸易休战期之际，一桩新的间谍丑闻表明，在他们的外交背后，存在一场激烈的情报较量。 At its center is Jensen Huang, the Nvidia leader and an influential ally of Mr. Trump’s, who has acknowledged having an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of spying for Beijing. China has denied the espionage allegation. 处于事件中心的是英伟达领导人、特朗普的重要盟友黄仁勋，他已承认与一名中国女商人发生婚外情，而美国情报官员怀疑这名女商人为北京从事间谍活动。中国否认了这一间谍指控。 Under Mr. Xi, the Chinese Communist Party has built a more sophisticated and assertive spy service that regularly highlights the importance of technological security and of threats posed by the United States. At the same time, the Central Intelligence Agency has said that Chinese companies are a legitimate target for espionage in areas like artificial intelligence, semiconductors and biotechnology. 在习近平的领导下，中国共产党建立了一个更加成熟且强势的间谍机构，该机构经常强调技术安全的重要性以及美国构成的威胁。与此同时，美国中央情报局表示，在人工智能、半导体和生物技术等领域，中国企业是间谍活动的合法目标。 Nvidia’s computer chips power the global A.I. boom and sit at the center of Washington’s efforts to keep that technology out of China’s hands. That makes Mr. Huang, who has lobbied Mr. Trump to ease restrictions on the export of advanced chips to China, a prime target, analysts say. 英伟达的计算机芯片推动了全球人工智能热潮，也成为华盛顿阻止中国掌握人工智能技术的核心所在。分析人士指出，这使得曾游说特朗普放宽对华先进芯片出口限制的黄仁勋成为了首要目标。 “It is not at all surprising, given the centrality of Nvidia to U.S.-China tech competition, and the importance of tech competition in the overall U.S.-China rivalry, that someone like him would be a top target for Chinese intelligence collection,” said Sheena Chestnut Greitens, an expert on Chinese security at the University of Texas at Austin. “鉴于英伟达在中美科技竞争中的核心地位，以及科技竞争在整个中美较量中的重要性，像他这样的人成为中国情报收集的首要目标，一点也不令人惊讶，”得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的中国安全问题专家希娜·切斯特纳特·格雷滕斯说。 这张从CTI视频片段中截取的静态图像显示，黄乐去年在台湾一家餐厅与黄仁勋共进晚餐。 U.S. agencies concluded that the Chinese businesswoman, who goes by Alice Huang, was an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security. Nvidia has said that it is conducting an internal investigation. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. 美国情报机构得出结论认为，这位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女商人是中国国家安全部的线人。英伟达表示正在进行内部调查。黄乐尚未对置评请求作出回应。 “It is brazen, and yet I don’t think we should be surprised at all,” said Christopher K. Johnson, a former U.S. government intelligence officer who is now president of China Strategies Group, a risk consultancy. “Whenever the Chinese declare something a national strategic, whole-of-society priority, like they have done with chips and A.I., that implies they will use every tool available to them to work, buy or steal their way to that end.” “这种行为虽然明目张胆，但我认为我们完全不应感到惊讶，”前美国政府情报官员、现任风险咨询公司中国战略集团总裁的克里斯托弗·K·约翰逊说。“每当中国人宣布某件事是国家战略、全社会的优先事项时——就像他们在芯片和人工智能领域所做的那样，这就意味着他们将使用所有可用的工具，通过工作、购买或窃取的方式来达到这一目的。” So far, the scandal has not apparently disrupted plans for Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi to meet next week in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. Mr. Trump said on Monday that he did not plan to bring the matter up with Mr. Xi. He has repeatedly downplayed reports of Chinese spying and cyberattacks on the United States, arguing that Washington does the same. 迄今为止，这桩丑闻显然并未打乱特朗普和习近平下周在中国南方城市深圳会面的计划。特朗普周一表示，他不打算向习近平提及此事。他曾多次淡化有关中国对美国进行间谍活动和网络攻击的报道，并称华盛顿也在做同样的事情。 That is a contrast with the Biden administration, which confronted China in early 2023 about a spy balloon that was spotted drifting across the continental United States. Official relations between the countries froze for months. 这与拜登政府形成了鲜明对比——2023年初，拜登政府曾就一架被发现漂浮穿越美国本土的间谍气球一事向中国提出交涉。两国官方关系因此冻结了数月。 Mr. Trump’s approach could embolden China to take bigger risks, said Dennis Wilder, a former U.S. intelligence analyst on China and a senior fellow at Georgetown University. 乔治城大学高级研究员、前美国对华情报分析师韦德宁(Dennis Wilder)表示，特朗普的做法可能会让中国胆子更大，愿意冒更大的风险。 “The president’s whole laissez-faire attitude toward spying reassures Beijing that the political blowback from espionage operations will be very manageable,” he said. “总统对间谍活动的整体放任态度让北京确信，间谍行动带来的政治反弹将是非常可控的，”他说。 Mr. Huang was until recently also expected to travel to Shenzhen. When Mr. Xi visited the United States in September, the tech executive was a guest at the White House state dinner. He had joined a presidential trip to Beijing in May at Mr. Trump’s invitation. 直到前不久，黄仁勋原本还计划前往深圳。9月习近平访美时，这位科技高管曾作为嘉宾出席白宫国宴。5月，他应特朗普的邀请，随总统出访北京。 “The president has over and over dismissed Chinese spying by saying that everyone does it,” Mr. Wilder said. “The problem is that no one else does it to the very damaging effect that the Chinese can and do.” “总统一次又一次地对中国间谍活动轻描淡写，说大家都在这么做，”韦德宁说。“问题在于，其他国家无法也不会像中国那样造成如此严重的破坏性后果。” In recent years, Chinese spies have been accused of targeting the phones of American presidential candidates, recruiting U.S. Navy sailors, cultivating political aides, and planting malicious code in power grids and water systems that Americans rely on every day. 近年来，中国间谍被指针对美国总统候选人的手机开展行动，招募美国海军水手，收买政治助理，并在美国人日常依赖的电网和水务系统中植入恶意代码。 Beijing also a history of ruthless counterintelligence operations. From 2010 through 2012, the Chinese government killed or imprisoned 18 to 20 of the C.I.A.’s sources in China, crippling American spying there for years, The New York Times reported in 2017. 北京也有开展无情反间谍行动的历史。据《纽约时报》2017年报道，从2010年到2012年，中国政府杀害或监禁了18到20名中央情报局在中国的线人，导致美国在华间谍活动在此后多年里陷入瘫痪。 Espionage has repeatedly strained relations, at times erupting into diplomatic crises, as when a U.S. Navy surveillance plane collided with a Chinese fighter jet in 2001 near China’s Hainan Island, killing the Chinese pilot. Beijing condemned Washington for spying and held the 24 American crew members for 11 days. 间谍活动屡屡导致两国关系紧张，有时还会引发外交危机。例如2001年，一架美国海军侦察机在中国海南岛附近与一架中国战斗机相撞，导致中国飞行员丧生。北京谴责华盛顿从事间谍活动，并将24名美国机组人员扣留了11天。 A More Sophisticated Spy Agency 一个更成熟的间谍机构 China’s lead intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security, has transformed from a service that relied on gathering gossip at embassy dinner parties into a sophisticated spy shop that can go toe-to-toe with the C.I.A. with bigger budgets and modern tools like A.I. 中国的首要情报机构国家安全部曾经只是一个依靠在使馆晚宴上收集流言蜚语的机构，如今已经转变成了有雄厚预算和人工智能等现代化工具、能够与中央情报局正面交锋的成熟间谍机构。 Its political standing has risen as well. In 2022, Mr. Xi elevated the ministry’s then chief, Chen Wenqing, to the Communist Party’s Politburo, a council of the 24 most senior national leaders. He was the first spy chief in decades to ascend to that body. 它的政治地位也有所提高。2022年，习近平将该部时任部长陈文清提拔进了由24名国家最高领导人组成的中共中央政治局。他是几十年来首位晋升该机构的情报部门负责人。 The once-shadowy ministry has also stepped into public view, posting a stream of warnings on its WeChat social media account about foreign spies. It has publicized examples of Chinese nationals working for the government and a military contractor in Tokyo and Rome being recruited by C.I.A. officers to provide information about the government or the military. 这个曾经行事隐秘的部门也步入了公众视野，在其微信账号上接连发布关于外国间谍的警告。它还公布了一些案例：在东京和罗马，为政府和军事承包商工作的两位中国公民被中央情报局官员招募，以提供有关政府或军队的信息。 2023年在北京的一次会议上，被提拔进入政治局的情报机构负责人陈文清（右二）。 At the same time, the United States has stepped up its intelligence gathering to include not just military and government targets, but also private Chinese companies, the deputy C.I.A. director, Michael Ellis, told a cybersecurity conference this year. Compared with past geopolitical rivals, China “poses a fundamentally different kind of threat to us because the competition is economic,” Mr. Ellis said. 与此同时，美国中央情报局副局长迈克尔·埃利斯在今年的一次网络安全会议上表示，美国加强了情报收集工作，不仅包括军事和政府目标，还包括中国私营企业。埃利斯说，与过去的地缘政治对手相比，中国“对我们构成了根本上不同类型的威胁，因为这种竞争是经济方面的”。 The C.I.A. has also taken the unusual step of recruiting in public, producing a series of Mandarin-language videos urging disaffected Chinese officials to share secrets with the United States. (The Ministry of State Security’s WeChat account mocked the videos as “crude,” “farcical” and a sign of the C.I.A.’s “baffling incompetence.”) 中央情报局还采取了不同寻常的公开招募举措，制作了一系列普通话视频，敦促心怀不满的中国官员向美国透露机密。（中国国家安全部的微信账号嘲笑这些视频“蹩脚”、“拙劣可笑”，并称这是中央情报局“无能”的标志。） 黄乐曾任一家总部位于新加坡、专门采购英伟达先进芯片的公司Megaspeed的高管。 China Pushes Back 中国的反驳 In China, the case has drawn official denials and questions about what Beijing would stand to gain. 在中国，此案引发了官方的否认，并引发了外界对北京方面能从中获得什么利益的质疑。 Ms. Huang had been an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed that buys advanced Nvidia chips. The United States began restricting sales of advanced chips directly to China in late 2022, but Chinese companies can lease computing power from data centers that use those chips in Southeast Asia, like the ones Megaspeed operates. 黄乐曾是一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡公司的高管，该公司购买先进的英伟达芯片。美国于2022年底开始限制直接向中国销售先进芯片，但中国公司可以从东南亚使用这些芯片的数据中心（例如Megaspeed运营的数据中心）租赁算力。 At the same time, China has also encouraged domestic companies to make do with less powerful domestically produced chips to promote greater national self-reliance, leading some analysts to question the significance of the Nvidia case. 与此同时，中国也鼓励国内企业将就使用功能较弱的国产芯片，以促进国家自给自足，这让一些分析人士对英伟达案的重要性提出质疑。 “China does not want to import so many Nvidia chips,” said Shen Dingli, an international relations scholar in Shanghai. “They are trying to force Chinese companies to use Chinese chips from Huawei.” “中国不想进口那么多英伟达芯片，”上海的国际关系学者沈丁立说。“他们正试图迫使中国企业使用华为的国产芯片。” The Chinese Foreign Ministry has rejected the espionage allegations surrounding Ms. Huang as “nothing but a smear against China.” On Chinese social media platforms, which are heavily censored, comments about Mr. Huang have centered on his extramarital affair. 中国外交部驳斥了围绕黄乐的间谍指控，称其纯属“污蔑抹黑”。在审查严格的中国社交媒体平台上，有关黄仁勋的评论主要集中在他的婚外情上。 Nationalist commentators in China have described the scandal as an effort that brings together American opponents of China, Mr. Trump, and artificial intelligence. 中国的民族主义评论将这桩丑闻描述为一次将美国反对中国、特朗普和人工智能的势力结合在一起的行动。 Ren Yi, a Harvard-educated Chinese blogger who goes by the pen name “Chairman Rabbit,” wrote: “Once again, anti-China politics weaves America’s disparate political causes together.” 曾在哈佛大学就读、笔名为“兔主席”的中国博主任意写道：“反华再次把美国的各种议题联系到了一起。” Berry Wang对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: DAVID PIERSON 2026年11月12日 9月，在白宫举行的国宴上，特朗普总统（左）和黄仁勋（右）聆听中国国家主席习近平的讲话。 Doug Mills/The New York Times As President Trump and China’s leader, Xi Jinping, prepare to meet next week to extend a fragile trade truce, a fresh espionage scandal has shown that behind their diplomacy is a fierce intelligence rivalry. 就在特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平准备下周会面以延长脆弱的贸易休战期之际，一桩新的间谍丑闻表明，在他们的外交背后，存在一场激烈的情报较量。 At its center is Jensen Huang, the Nvidia leader and an influential ally of Mr. Trump’s, who has acknowledged having an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of spying for Beijing. China has denied the espionage allegation. 处于事件中心的是英伟达领导人、特朗普的重要盟友黄仁勋，他已承认与一名 中国女商人 发生婚外情，而美国情报官员怀疑这名女商人为北京从事间谍活动。中国否认了这一间谍指控。 Under Mr. Xi, the Chinese Communist Party has built a more sophisticated and assertive spy service that regularly highlights the importance of technological security and of threats posed by the United States. At the same time, the Central Intelligence Agency has said that Chinese companies are a legitimate target for espionage in areas like artificial intelligence, semiconductors and biotechnology. 在习近平的领导下，中国共产党建立了一个更加成熟且强势的间谍机构，该机构经常强调技术安全的重要性以及美国构成的威胁。与此同时，美国中央情报局表示，在人工智能、半导体和生物技术等领域，中国企业是间谍活动的合法目标。 Nvidia’s computer chips power the global A.I. boom and sit at the center of Washington’s efforts to keep that technology out of China’s hands. That makes Mr. Huang, who has lobbied Mr. Trump to ease restrictions on the export of advanced chips to China, a prime target, analysts say. 英伟达的计算机芯片 推动了全球人工智能热潮 ，也成为华盛顿阻止中国掌握人工智能技术的核心所在。分析人士指出，这使得曾游说特朗普放宽对华先进芯片出口限制的黄仁勋成为了首要目标。 “It is not at all surprising, given the centrality of Nvidia to U.S.-China tech competition, and the importance of tech competition in the overall U.S.-China rivalry, that someone like him would be a top target for Chinese intelligence collection,” said Sheena Chestnut Greitens, an expert on Chinese security at the University of Texas at Austin. “鉴于英伟达在中美科技竞争中的核心地位，以及科技竞争在整个中美较量中的重要性，像他这样的人成为中国情报收集的首要目标，一点也不令人惊讶，”得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的中国安全问题专家希娜·切斯特纳特·格雷滕斯说。 这张从CTI视频片段中截取的静态图像显示，黄乐去年在台湾一家餐厅与黄仁勋共进晚餐。 U.S. agencies concluded that the Chinese businesswoman, who goes by Alice Huang, was an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security. Nvidia has said that it is conducting an internal investigation . Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment. 美国情报机构得出结论认为，这位名叫黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国女商人是中国国家安全部的线人。英伟达表示 正在进行内部调查 。黄乐尚未对置评请求作出回应。 “It is brazen, and yet I don’t think we should be surprised at all,” said Christopher K. Johnson, a former U.S. government intelligence officer who is now president of China Strategies Group, a risk consultancy. “Whenever the Chinese declare something a national strategic, whole-of-society priority, like they have done with chips and A.I., that implies they will use every tool available to them to work, buy or steal their way to that end.” “这种行为虽然明目张胆，但我认为我们完全不应感到惊讶，”前美国政府情报官员、现任风险咨询公司中国战略集团总裁的克里斯托弗·K·约翰逊说。“每当中国人宣布某件事是国家战略、全社会的优先事项时——就像他们在芯片和人工智能领域所做的那样，这就意味着他们将使用所有可用的工具，通过工作、购买或窃取的方式来达到这一目的。” So far, the scandal has not apparently disrupted plans for Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi to meet next week in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. Mr. Trump said on Monday that he did not plan to bring the matter up with Mr. Xi. He has repeatedly downplayed reports of Chinese spying and cyberattacks on the United States, arguing that Washington does the same. 迄今为止，这桩丑闻显然并未打乱特朗普和习近平下周在中国南方城市深圳会面的计划。特朗普 周一表示 ，他不打算向习近平提及此事。他曾多次淡化有关中国对美国进行间谍活动和网络攻击的报道，并称华盛顿也在做同样的事情。 That is a contrast with the Biden administration, which confronted China in early 2023 about a spy balloon that was spotted drifting across the continental United States. Official relations between the countries froze for months. 这与拜登政府形成了鲜明对比——2023年初，拜登政府曾就一架被发现漂浮穿越美国本土的 间谍气球 一事向中国提出交涉。两国官方关系因此冻结了数月。 Mr. Trump’s approach could embolden China to take bigger risks, said Dennis Wilder, a former U.S. intelligence analyst on China and a senior fellow at Georgetown University. 乔治城大学高级研究员、前美国对华情报分析师韦德宁(Dennis Wilder)表示，特朗普的做法可能会让中国胆子更大，愿意冒更大的风险。 “The president’s whole laissez-faire attitude toward spying reassures Beijing that the political blowback from espionage operations will be very manageable,” he said. “总统对间谍活动的整体放任态度让北京确信，间谍行动带来的政治反弹将是非常可控的，”他说。 Mr. Huang was until recently also expected to travel to Shenzhen. When Mr. Xi visited the United States in September, the tech executive was a guest at the White House state dinner.
