From 2010 through 2012, the Chinese government killed or imprisoned 18 to 20 of the C.I.A.’s sources in China, crippling American spying there for years, The New York Times reported in 2017 . 北京也有开展无情反间谍行动的历史。据《纽约时报》 2017年报道 ，从2010年到2012年，中国政府杀害或监禁了18到20名中央情报局在中国的线人，导致美国在华间谍活动在此后多年里陷入瘫痪。 Espionage has repeatedly strained relations, at times erupting into diplomatic crises, as when a U.S. Navy surveillance plane collided with a Chinese fighter jet in 2001 near China’s Hainan Island, killing the Chinese pilot. Beijing condemned Washington for spying and held the 24 American crew members for 11 days. 间谍活动屡屡导致两国关系紧张，有时还会引发外交危机。例如2001年，一架美国海军侦察机在中国海南岛附近 与一架中国战斗机相撞 ，导致中国飞行员丧生。北京谴责华盛顿从事间谍活动，并将24名美国机组人员扣留了11天。 A More Sophisticated Spy Agency 一个更成熟的间谍机构 China’s lead intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security, has transformed from a service that relied on gathering gossip at embassy dinner parties into a sophisticated spy shop that can go toe-to-toe with the C.I.A . with bigger budgets and modern tools like A.I. 中国的首要情报机构国家安全部曾经只是一个依靠在使馆晚宴上收集流言蜚语的机构，如今已经转变成了有雄厚预算和人工智能等现代化工具、能够 与中央情报局正面交锋 的成熟间谍机构。 Its political standing has risen as well. In 2022, Mr. Xi elevated the ministry’s then chief, Chen Wenqing, to the Communist Party’s Politburo, a council of the 24 most senior national leaders. He was the first spy chief in decades to ascend to that body. 它的政治地位也有所提高。2022年，习近平将该部时任部长陈文清提拔进了由24名国家最高领导人组成的中共中央政治局。他是几十年来首位晋升该机构的情报部门负责人。 The once-shadowy ministry has also stepped into public view, posting a stream of warnings on its WeChat social media account about foreign spies. It has publicized examples of Chinese nationals working for the government and a military contractor in Tokyo and Rome being recruited by C.I.A. officers to provide information about the government or the military. 这个曾经行事隐秘的部门也步入了公众视野，在其微信账号上接连发布关于外国间谍的警告。它还公布了一些案例：在东京和罗马， 为政府和军事承包商工作的两位中国公民 被中央情报局官员招募，以提供有关政府或军队的信息。 2023年在北京的一次会议上，被提拔进入政治局的情报机构负责人陈文清（右二）。 At the same time, the United States has stepped up its intelligence gathering to include not just military and government targets, but also private Chinese companies, the deputy C.I.A. director, Michael Ellis, told a cybersecurity conference this year. Compared with past geopolitical rivals, China “poses a fundamentally different kind of threat to us because the competition is economic,” Mr. Ellis said. 与此同时，美国中央情报局副局长迈克尔·埃利斯 在今年的一次网络安全会议上表示 ，美国加强了情报收集工作，不仅包括军事和政府目标，还包括中国私营企业。埃利斯说，与过去的地缘政治对手相比，中国“对我们构成了根本上不同类型的威胁，因为这种竞争是经济方面的”。 The C.I.A. has also taken the unusual step of recruiting in public, producing a series of Mandarin-language videos urging disaffected Chinese officials to share secrets with the United States. (The Ministry of State Security’s WeChat account mocked the videos as “crude,” “farcical” and a sign of the C.I.A.’s “baffling incompetence.”) 中央情报局还采取了不同寻常的公开招募举措，制作了 一系列普通话视频 ，敦促心怀不满的中国官员向美国透露机密。（中国国家安全部的微信账号嘲笑这些视频“蹩脚”、“拙劣可笑”，并称这是中央情报局“无能”的标志。） 黄乐曾任一家总部位于新加坡、专门采购英伟达先进芯片的公司Megaspeed的高管。 China Pushes Back 中国的反驳 In China, the case has drawn official denials and questions about what Beijing would stand to gain. 在中国，此案引发了官方的否认，并引发了外界对北京方面能从中获得什么利益的质疑。 Ms. Huang had been an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed that buys advanced Nvidia chips. The United States began restricting sales of advanced chips directly to China in late 2022, but Chinese companies can lease computing power from data centers that use those chips in Southeast Asia, like the ones Megaspeed operates. 黄乐曾是一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡公司的高管，该公司购买先进的英伟达芯片。美国于2022年底开始限制直接向中国销售先进芯片，但中国公司可以从东南亚使用这些芯片的数据中心（例如Megaspeed运营的数据中心）租赁算力。 At the same time, China has also encouraged domestic companies to make do with less powerful domestically produced chips to promote greater national self-reliance, leading some analysts to question the significance of the Nvidia case. 与此同时，中国也鼓励国内企业将就使用功能较弱的国产芯片，以促进国家自给自足，这让一些分析人士对英伟达案的重要性提出质疑。 “China does not want to import so many Nvidia chips,” said Shen Dingli, an international relations scholar in Shanghai. “They are trying to force Chinese companies to use Chinese chips from Huawei.” “中国不想进口那么多英伟达芯片，”上海的国际关系学者沈丁立说。“他们正试图迫使中国企业使用华为的国产芯片。” The Chinese Foreign Ministry has rejected the espionage allegations surrounding Ms. Huang as “nothing but a smear against China.” On Chinese social media platforms, which are heavily censored, comments about Mr. Huang have centered on his extramarital affair. 中国外交部 驳斥了围绕黄乐的间谍指控 ，称其纯属“污蔑抹黑”。在审查严格的中国社交媒体平台上，有关黄仁勋的评论主要集中在他的婚外情上。 Nationalist commentators in China have described the scandal as an effort that brings together American opponents of China, Mr. Trump, and artificial intelligence. 中国的民族主义评论将这桩丑闻描述为一次将美国反对中国、特朗普和人工智能的势力结合在一起的行动。 Ren Yi, a Harvard-educated Chinese blogger who goes by the pen name “Chairman Rabbit,” wrote: “Once again, anti-China politics weaves America’s disparate political causes together.” 曾在哈佛大学就读、笔名为“兔主席”的中国博主任意写道：“反华再次把美国的各种议题联系到了一起。” Berry Wang对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson 报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 黄仁勋婚外情丑闻将其妻子置于聚光灯下
description: ERIN GRIFFITH, DON CLARK2026年11月12日英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与妻子洛丽·黄相识于俄勒冈州立大学，当时两人都是工程专业的学生。 Carolyn Kaster/Associated Press In November 2021, Jensen Huang attended the annual dinner held by the Semiconductor Industry Association in San Jose, Calif. That night, the trade group gave Mr. Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia, its highest honor, named for the Intel co-founder Robert Noyce. 2021年11月，黄仁勋出席了半导体行业协会在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举办的年度晚宴。当晚，该行业组织向身为英伟达首席执行官的黄仁勋颁发了以英特尔联合创始人罗伯特·诺伊斯命名的最高荣誉。 Mr. Huang arrived early with his wife, Lori Huang, and quickly headed to the bar at the pre-dinner reception, saying the event was the first time he had been out of his house since the Covid lockdown began in March 2020. He introduced Ms. Huang to reporters who clustered nearby, but they mainly talked to him. 黄仁勋与妻子洛丽·黄早早抵达，并迅速走向晚宴前招待会的吧台，称这次活动是他自2020年3月新冠疫情封锁开始以来首次出门。他将洛丽·黄介绍给聚集在附近的记者，但记者们主要还是与他交谈。 By the time Mr. Huang received the award, two hours had passed. The Nvidia leader walked onstage with a bottle of red wine and two glasses, sharing them with a moderator and taking the conversation into unexpected topics. Throughout, Ms. Huang remained in the background. 到黄仁勋领奖时，两个小时已经过去了。这位英伟达领导者拿着一瓶红酒和两个酒杯走上舞台，与主持人分享，并将对话引向意想不到的话题。在此期间，洛丽·黄一直留在幕后。 For more than 40 years, Ms. Huang has been by Mr. Huang’s side as he built his fledgling chip start-up into one of the most valuable companies in the world. Nvidia’s success turned Mr. Huang into an international business star. His face is on sweaters, his signature leather jackets have become collectors items, and his net worth has soared to nearly $150 billion. 40多年来，黄仁勋将他刚刚起步的芯片初创公司打造成全球最具价值的企业，洛丽·黄全程一直陪伴在他身边。英伟达的成功让他成为国际商业明星。他的面孔出现在毛衣上，他的标志性皮夹克成为收藏品，他的净资产飙升至近1500亿美元。 By contrast, Ms. Huang stayed far from the spotlight. 相比之下，洛丽·黄远离聚光灯。 That changed this week, when Mr. Huang, 63, revealed he had an affair with an executive identified by the U.S. government as a Chinese spy. In his admission, which he shared in a message to Nvidia employees, Mr. Huang apologized to his wife, as well as his two children, who both work at Nvidia, thrusting them into the limelight. 这种情况在本周发生了改变，63岁的黄仁勋透露他与一名被美国政府认定为中国间谍的高管发生了婚外情。在向英伟达员工分享的信息中，黄仁勋向他的妻子以及都在英伟达工作的两个孩子道歉，这让他们突然进入了公众的视野。 The bombshell news had implications for U.S. national security and the economy. Nvidia’s role as the A.I. industry’s main supplier of chips makes Mr. Huang a crucial linchpin for an industry that has come to dominate the stock market. 这则重磅新闻对美国国家安全和经济产生了影响。英伟达作为人工智能行业主要芯片供应商的角色使黄仁勋成为了一个已经主导股票市场的行业的关键核心人物。 8月，任职英伟达产品营销高级总监的黄敏珊在北京举行的2026年世界机器人大会上。去年，英伟达机器人产品总监黄黄胜斌在台北南港展览馆。 It also has ramifications for his personal life. Mr. Huang’s admission has fueled speculation about the fate of his 41-year marriage with Ms. Huang, 64. She is president of the Jen-Hsun Lori Huang Foundation, which had $9 billion in assets as of 2024, including $6 billion in fresh funding that year. Of Mr. Huang’s 922 million Nvidia shares, more than half belong to a trust where Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang are the co-trustees, according to financial filings. She is also the sole controller of a trust that owns around $5 billion worth of Nvidia shares. 这也给他的个人生活带来了影响。他的承认引发了关于他与64岁的洛丽·黄41年婚姻命运的猜测。她是黄仁勋与洛丽·黄基金会的主席，截至2024年，该基金会拥有90亿美元资产，其中包括当年60亿美元的新增资金。根据财务文件，在黄仁勋的9.22亿股英伟达股票中，超过一半属于一个信托基金，黄仁勋和洛丽·黄是该信托的共同受托人。她还是一个拥有价值约50亿美元英伟达股票的信托基金的唯一控制人。 Ms. Huang joins a small group of tech titan spouses who have had to grapple with public infidelity. The list includes MacKenzie Scott, the ex-wife of the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, and Melinda French Gates, ex-wife of the Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates. She has not promoted her philanthropic work in interviews or on the conference circuit. 在位高权重的现任和前任商业领袖的配偶中，洛丽·黄的公众形象因其低调私密而显得与众不同。她没有在采访或会议巡回活动中宣传过自己的慈善工作。 “Lori is unusually modest by the standards of billionaire couples,” said George Rush, who formerly coauthored Rush & Molloy, a long-running gossip column at The Daily News. “以亿万富翁夫妇的标准来看，洛丽异乎寻常地低调，”曾在《每日新闻》(The Daily News)共同撰写长期八卦专栏“拉什与莫洛伊”(Rush & Molloy)的乔治·拉什表示。 That adds further intrigue to the political and economic consequences of the affair, Mr. Rush noted. “Bezos and Gates didn’t have this dynamic, where the relationship could move markets and have this global fallout,” he said. “It is one of a kind.” 拉什指出，这使这起婚外情在政治和经济后果上更加引人关注。“贝佐斯和盖茨夫妇的关系不存在这种能够撼动市场并产生全球性影响的特性，”他说。“这是独一无二的。” Nvidia declined to comment and Ms. Huang did not respond to a request for comment. (China has rejected the espionage claims. Alice Huang, the Chinese executive accused of spying for Beijing, has not responded to requests for comment.) 英伟达拒绝置评，洛丽·黄也没有回应置评请求。（中国已否认间谍指控。被指控为北京从事间谍活动的中国高管黄乐未回应置评请求。） Similar to other tech billionaire spouses like Ms. Scott, Ms. Huang was crucial to the start of her husband’s company. 与斯科特等其他科技亿万富翁的配偶类似，洛丽·黄对她丈夫公司的起步至关重要。 She met Mr. Huang as one of a handful of women studying engineering at Oregon State University in the early 1980s. Mr. Huang was her lab partner in an electrical engineering fundamentals class, and he convinced her to join him for a weekly study date. Just before he co-founded Nvidia in 1993, Ms. Huang gave up her career to raise their children, Spencer and Madison. Madison’s husband, Nico Caprez, also works there. 她甚至帮助塑造了他的公众形象。她和女儿黄敏珊一起让黄仁勋穿上了一件设计师皮夹克，这成了他的标志性造型。黄敏珊于2020年加入英伟达，黄胜斌也于2022年入职。黄敏珊的丈夫尼科·卡普雷兹也在那里工作。 Mr. Huang ended his message to Nvidia employees about the affair with a request: “My family bears no responsibility for my choices. I do. Please give them privacy.” 在向英伟达员工发送的关于婚外情的信件末尾，黄仁勋提出了一个请求：“我的家人对我的选择不承担任何责任。责任在我。请给他们隐私。” Georgia Gee对本文有研究贡献。 Erin Griffith 自旧金山报道科技公司、初创企业，以及硅谷文化。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 马斯克等硅谷盟友力挺黄仁勋，称其“不可替代”
description: EMMY MARTIN2026年11月12日去年，埃隆·马斯克与黄仁勋出席在沙特阿拉伯举行的一场投资论坛。马斯克和多名科技行业投资人都公开表达了对黄仁勋的支持。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times Within hours of Jensen Huang’s admission on Sunday that he had been unfaithful to his wife, some of Silicon Valley’s most influential investors closed ranks around him. 黄仁勋周日承认对妻子不忠后数小时内，硅谷一些最有影响力的投资人便纷纷站出来力挺他。 Their messages, delivered mostly on social media, were consistent. Mr. Huang’s relationship with a woman identified by U.S. officials as a Chinese spy was a personal failing. Losing the Nvidia chief executive, they argued, would be a far bigger blow to the country, and America couldn’t win the artificial intelligence race without him. 他们主要通过社交媒体发声，传递的信息高度一致：黄仁勋与一名被美国官员认定为中国间谍的女子有染是个人过失。他们认为，若失去这位英伟达首席执行官，对国家将是大得多的打击，没有黄仁勋，美国就无法赢得人工智能竞赛。 “Jensen is one of the greatest entrepreneurs of this generation,” Shaun Maguire, a partner at Sequoia Capital, wrote in a post on Sunday afternoon. He said that Mr. Huang “did something incredibly dumb,” and that it was bad for America, “but my guess is there was no bad intention.” He concluded that Mr. Huang is “irreplaceable for America’s AI leadership.” “黄仁勋是这一代最杰出的企业家之一，”红杉资本合伙人肖恩·马奎尔周日下午发帖写道。他表示，黄仁勋“做了一件极其愚蠢的事”，这对美国不利，“但我猜他并无恶意”。他最后总结说，黄仁勋“对于美国在人工智能领域的领导地位而言，是不可替代的”。 About an hour later, Elon Musk quoted the post and added: “I agree.” 大约一个小时后，埃隆·马斯克转发了这篇帖文，并补充道：“我同意。” The show of loyalty reflects Mr. Huang’s rarefied standing in Silicon Valley. In the three decades since he co-founded Nvidia, he has gone from running a maker of video game graphics cards to presiding over the company at the center of the A.I. boom, now one of the world’s most valuable companies. 这些支持反映了黄仁勋在硅谷举足轻重的地位。自30多年前与他人共同创立英伟达以来，他从一家电子游戏显卡制造商的掌门人一步步成为人工智能热潮核心企业的领导者。如今，英伟达已是全球市值最高的公司之一。 Nvidia’s chips are the scarce resource every A.I. company needs, a position that makes Mr. Huang something of a kingmaker. Decisions about who gets his products, and how many, can shape which start-ups and tech giants pull ahead. Nvidia’s finances are also deeply intertwined with other leading A.I. companies, including OpenAI and Anthropic. 英伟达的芯片是所有人工智能公司都需要的稀缺资源，这让黄仁勋在某种程度上成为了“造王者”。谁获得他的产品、获得多少都可能影响哪些初创企业和科技巨头能够脱颖而出。英伟达的财务也与OpenAI和Anthropic等领先的人工智能公司有着密切联系。 (China has rejected the espionage claims. Alice Huang, the Chinese executive accused of spying for Beijing, has not responded to requests for comment.) （中国否认了相关指控。被指为北京从事间谍活动的中国女高管黄乐[Alice Huang]尚未回应置评请求。） Bill Ackman, the billionaire hedge fund manager, called Mr. Huang “an incredible human” who took “full responsibility as he should,” and urged people to “support him and his family.” Later on Sunday, Mr. Ackman added that he was “not suggesting he gets a free pass.” 亿万富豪、对冲基金经理比尔·阿克曼称黄仁勋是“一个了不起的人”，他“承担了自己理应承担的全部责任”，并呼吁人们“支持他和他的家人”。周日晚些时候，阿克曼又补充说，他“并不是说应该让他免于承担责任”。 On Monday, the investor Gavin Baker argued that many venture capitalists were “patriotic Americans” who believed Mr. Huang’s policy views served the country against China. He wrote that it would be “a disaster for America — and a gift to China — if Jensen goes down.” 周一，投资人加文·贝克主张，许多风险投资家是“爱国的美国人”，他们相信黄仁勋的政策主张有助于美国在对华竞争中取胜。他写道，“如果黄仁勋倒下，对美国将是一场灾难，却是送给中国的一份大礼。” “100% in agreement,” replied Jason Calacanis, a host of the All-In podcast, which is a popular podcast hosted by a group of venture capitalists including David Sacks, President Trump’s former A.I. and crypto czar. “百分之百同意，”杰森·卡拉卡尼斯回复道。他是热门播客节目《All-In》的主持人之一。该节目由一群风险投资家共同主持，其中包括曾任特朗普总统人工智能与加密货币事务主管的戴维·萨克斯。 Antonio Gracias, the founder of Valor Equity Partners and a longtime associate of Mr. Musk, agreed on Tuesday: “America would not be ahead in the AI race without Jensen,” he wrote. “He clearly made a mistake. One mistake does not erase a lifetime of leadership.” 周二，Valor Equity Partners创始人、马斯克的多年商业伙伴安东尼奥·格拉西亚斯也表示赞同。“没有黄仁勋，美国就不可能在人工智能竞赛中领先，”他写道。“他显然犯了一个错误。但一次错误不能抹杀他一生的领导成就。” The All-In hosts have been close to Mr. Huang. During an appearance onstage with the podcast’s hosts in September, Mr. Huang took a phone call from Mr. Trump. 《All-In》的几位主持人与黄仁勋关系密切。今年9月，黄仁勋与该播客的主持人一同登台时，还接到了特朗普的电话。 Mr. Trump, too, has stood by Mr. Huang. “I really believe him,” he said on Monday, recalling a conversation when Mr. Huang told him he did not know that Ms. Huang was a spy. The Times has reported that Mr. Trump was briefed a year ago about intelligence showing that Ms. Huang was an operative for the Chinese government. Mr. Trump on Tuesday demurred when asked whether he received the briefing last year. 特朗普也支持黄仁勋。“我真的相信他，”他周一说，并回忆起黄仁勋告诉他不知道黄乐是间谍的那次谈话。《纽约时报》报道，特朗普一年前听取过情报简报，显示黄乐是中国政府特工。周二，当被问及去年是否收到该简报时，特朗普没有正面回应。 Mr. Huang has been among Washington’s most forceful voices against cutting China off from American chips, and has been an ally of Mr. Trump since his return to office. That, Mr. Calacanis acknowledged, makes him and his company “a critical target, and we need to protect them both.” 黄仁勋一直是华盛顿反对切断中国获取美国芯片渠道的最有力声音之一，自特朗普重返白宫以来，他也是特朗普的盟友。卡拉卡尼斯承认，这使黄仁勋及其公司成为“重点针对的目标，我们需要保护他们两者”。 In Congress, the Republican leaders of three influential House committees have asked Mr. Huang to appear for a closed-door briefing on his interactions with Ms. Huang. 在国会，众议院三个具有重要影响力的委员会的共和党领袖已要求黄仁勋出席一场闭门情况通报会，说明他与黄乐之间的交往情况。 The Times reported last month that U.S. officials had concluded Ms. Huang, a former executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore company that bought billions of dollars of Nvidia chips, had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security. 《纽约时报》上个月报道称，美国官员认定，黄乐已被中国国家安全部招募。她曾在新加坡公司Megaspeed担任高管，该公司购买了价值数十亿美元的英伟达芯片。 Nvidia’s board has opened an investigation, and says it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Beijing dismissed the allegations as smears. 英伟达董事会已经展开调查，并表示目前没有理由认为国家安全或公司机密受到损害。北京方面则斥责这些指控是污蔑抹黑。 Emmy Martin报道科技行业，常驻旧金山，她也是2026-27时报培训项目的成员。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普政府官员就英伟达事件发生冲突
description: ANA SWANSON, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月12日左为斯科特·贝森特，右为霍华德·卢特尼克。 The New York Times Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick last week over his handling of a Singaporean company at the heart of revelations about Chinese spying on Nvidia, demanding to know why the United States had not already banned sales of advanced A.I. chips to the firm. 上周，财政部长斯科特·贝森特就对一家新加坡公司的处理方式质问了商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，这家公司处于有关中国对英伟达开展间谍活动的信息披露的核心，他要求解释为何这家公司未被禁止购买美国的先进人工智能芯片。 The exchange, which took place at the White House on Thursday and was described by people briefed on it, highlighted growing tensions inside the Trump administration over A.I. policy in general and the Commerce Department’s posture toward Nvidia in particular. 此次交锋发生在上周四的白宫，据听取了相关简报的人士描述，这凸显出特朗普政府内部在整体人工智能政策上——尤其是商务部对英伟达的姿态上——存在日益紧张的对峙。 The internal debate has only intensified after Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, acknowledged he had an affair with a woman who had helped lead the Singaporean data center company, Megaspeed. The woman, Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, has been identified by U.S. intelligence as a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security, The New York Times has reported. 在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名曾参与执掌新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed的女性发生婚外情后，这种内部冲突进一步加剧。据《纽约时报》报道，这位名为黄乐(Alice Huang)的中国籍人士已被美国情报机构认定为中国国家安全部的间谍。 Mr. Lutnick responded to Mr. Bessent that the Commerce Department could now move quickly to put restrictions on Megaspeed in place, said the people briefed on the exchange, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the discussions were private. 听取了此次交锋简报的人士表示，卢特尼克回应贝森特说，商务部现在可以迅速采取行动对Megaspeed实施限制；由于讨论是私下的，这些人士要求匿名。 A spokeswoman for the Commerce Department denied that the conversation between Mr. Bessent and Mr. Lutnick had taken place. She said that the decision about whether to add companies to the entity list was an administration-wide one. 商务部的一位发言人否认贝森特与卢特尼克之间发生过这次对话。她表示，是否将一个企业列入实体清单是一个在全政府层面决策的问题。 The Treasury Department did not provide a comment. 财政部未予置评。 The United States has imposed restrictions since late 2022 on selling advanced chips directly to China. But Megaspeed and other companies have sidestepped those rules by setting up data centers in Southeast Asia to cater to Chinese clients. title: meta/astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready http://astryx.atmeta.com Astryx An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them. Currently in Beta · Built on React 19+ and StyleX Docs · Storybook · Sandbox · Contributing · Discord Overview Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling. What makes Astryx different: Open internals. Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API. The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own. No styling lock-in. Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers. Override with className using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS — whatever your project already uses. Customize without wrapping. A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without forking or wrapping component source. Built for people and agents. The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same reference. Getting Started Astryx requires React 19 or later (react and react-dom are peer dependencies of @astryxdesign/core). Install Astryx, a theme, and its peer dependencies: # npm npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli # pnpm pnpm add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex pnpm add -D @astryxdesign/cli # yarn yarn add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex yarn add -D @astryxdesign/cli You can also install the CLI once for your computer, so astryx works in any folder and every coding agent knows Astryx; in a project, it still runs that project's own version: npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli Project install, global install, or both? astryx docs global/project-global-or-both compares them (both is recommended), and astryx docs global explains how global mode works. The simplest setup is a few CSS imports plus a theme provider — no build plugin, no PostCSS or Babel config. See the @astryxdesign/core README for the full guide (Next.js, Tailwind, Vite, and CDN). For reliable CLI access, add a script to your package.json: "scripts": { "astryx": "node node_modules/@astryxdesign/cli/clients/cli/bin/astryx.mjs" } Then use it as npm run astryx -- component --list. This avoids path errors when AI assistants or new developers invoke the CLI directly. Packages Package Description README @astryxdesign/core Components, theme system, and utilities README @astryxdesign/cli CLI tooling: component docs, templates, scaffolding, themes, and codemods README @astryxdesign/build Build plugins for StyleX source builds README @astryxdesign/theme-* Seven ready-made, fully customizable themes (neutral, butter, chocolate, matcha, stone, gothic, y2k) README @astryxdesign/lab (experimental components) is used internally for Storybook and the sandbox and is not published to npm. @astryxdesign/vega (Vega/Vega-Lite chart wrapper) and @astryxdesign/charts (chart components) are published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag — there is no stable release yet. Principles These are the promises Astryx makes to the people building on it. Guidance over enforcement. Components give you capability rather than guardrails that fight you. Design opinions live in docs and examples — if you pass a value, the component renders it. Strong, documented conventions. Every component follows the same naming, prop, and composition rules, and every one is thoroughly documented — so once you've learned a few, the rest feel familiar, and both people and AI can predict how an unfamiliar component behaves. One system for humans and AI. The API, conventions, docs, and CLI are designed together so people and AI assistants build the same way. Every change that made Astryx easier for AI made it easier for people too. Earned by measurement. We test conventions rather than assert them, hold the results loosely, and revisit them when a new situation proves them wrong. Architecture Foundations The building blocks for visually cohesive and accessible interfaces: typography, color, layout, and accessibility. Components A library of 150+ reusable UI building blocks with full TypeScript support. Patterns Battle-tested design solutions for common interactions and workflows: table pages, detail page layouts, form wizards, navigation patterns, data entry flows. Project Structure Directory Purpose apps/ Example apps, the docsite, and Storybook packages/ Published packages: core, cli, build, themes internal/ Internal tooling: test utilities, eslint plugin, vibe tests Contributing We welcome contributions! See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full guide. Questions, or want a hand with a PR? Come find us in Discord. Our conventions and review rubrics live in the Contributing wiki — including API Conventions, Design Conventions, the Component Lifecycle, the Contributing Templates, and the Blog Review Rubric. Read the relevant rubric before opening a PR. Quick start for contributors: this repo uses Node 22+ on an active LTS line and pnpm 11. Install pnpm directly, or enable Corepack once so the pinned pnpm version installs automatically: corepack enable pnpm install If corepack is missing, install pnpm directly or install Corepack manually; see the troubleshooting notes in CONTRIBUTING.md. The Theme Showcase DOM tests use the root ui project for shared DOM and StyleX test setup. Run pnpm exec vitest run --project ui apps/docsite/src/__tests__/theme-showcase/ from the repository root. License MIT

Fork 本仓库 点击右上角 Fork 按钮（顺便点个 Star⭐ 支持一下） 2. 配置 Secrets Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret AI 模型配置（至少配置一个） 默认先选一个模型服务商并填写 API Key；需要多模型、图片识别、本地模型或高级路由时，再参考 LLM 配置指南。 Secret 名称 说明 必填 MODELFLARE_KEY Modelflare API Key，低成本接入全球热门大模型 推荐 AIHUBMIX_KEY AIHubMix API Key，一Key切换使用全系模型，无需科学上网，本项目可享 10% 优惠 推荐 GEMINI_API_KEY Google Gemini API Key 可选 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY Anthropic Claude API Key 可选 OPENAI_API_KEY OpenAI 兼容 API Key（支持 DeepSeek、通义千问等） 可选 OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_MODEL 使用 OpenAI 兼容服务时填写 可选 Ollama 更适合本地 / Docker 部署，GitHub Actions 推荐使用云端 API。 通知渠道配置（至少配置一个） Secret 名称 说明 WECHAT_WEBHOOK_URL 企业微信机器人 FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL 飞书机器人 TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID Telegram DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL Discord Webhook SLACK_BOT_TOKEN + SLACK_CHANNEL_ID Slack Bot EMAIL_SENDER + EMAIL_PASSWORD 邮件推送 更多渠道、签名校验、分组邮件、Markdown 转图片等配置见 通知渠道详细配置。 自选股配置（必填） Secret 名称 说明 必填 STOCK_LIST 自选股代码，如 600519,hk00700,AAPL,7203.T,005930.KS,2330.TW；已登记指数显式代码（如 sh000016、930606.CSI）经一次性 --stocks 或 GitHub Actions 入口支持，规则见 指数自选股配置 ✅ 新闻源配置（推荐） 新闻源会显著影响舆情、公告、事件和催化因素质量，建议至少配置一个搜索服务。 Secret 名称 说明 必填 SERPAPI_API_KEYS SerpAPI：搜索引擎结果补强，适合实时金融新闻 推荐 ANSPIRE_API_KEYS Anspire 搜索 API Key，可与其模型网关共用 可选 TAVILY_API_KEYS Tavily：通用新闻搜索 API 可选 BOCHA_API_KEYS 博查搜索：中文搜索优化，支持 AI 摘要 可选 BRAVE_API_KEYS Brave Search：隐私优先，美股资讯补强 可选 MINIMAX_API_KEYS MiniMax：结构化搜索结果 可选 SEARXNG_BASE_URLS SearXNG 自建实例：无配额兜底，适合私有部署 可选 更多搜索源、社交舆情和降级规则见 搜索服务配置。 行情数据源配置（可选） 默认使用 AkShare、Baostock、YFinance 等免费数据源，日志中"未配置"的提示不影响运行。 如需更稳定的行情，可按市场配置以下 Secret： Secret 名称 适用市场 说明 TUSHARE_TOKEN A 股 提升历史行情稳定性 LONGBRIDGE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID + LONGBRIDGE_OAUTH_TOKEN_CACHE_B64 港股/美股 补齐量比、换手率、PE 等字段 详见 数据源配置。 3. 启用 Actions Actions 标签 → I understand my workflows, go ahead and enable them 4. 手动测试 Actions → 每日股票分析 → Run workflow → Run workflow 完成 默认每个工作日 18:00（北京时间）自动执行，也可手动触发。默认非交易日（含 A/H/US 节假日）不执行；强制运行、交易日检查、断点续传等规则见 完整指南。 方式二：客户端配置教程 / 本地运行 / Docker 部署 # 克隆项目 git clone https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.git && cd daily_stock_analysis # 安装依赖 pip install -r requirements.txt # 配置环境变量 cp .env.example .env && vim .env # 运行分析 python main.py 常用命令： python main.py --debug python main.py --dry-run python main.py --stocks 600519,hk00700,AAPL,2330.TW python main.py --market-review python main.py --schedule python main.py --serve-only Docker 部署、定时任务、云服务器访问请参考 完整指南；桌面客户端打包请参考 桌面端打包说明。 📱 推送效果 决策仪表盘 🎯 2026-02-08 description: https://goo.gle/modern-web-guidance Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. Modern Web Guidance is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. See CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase. Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community. Documentation · Eval Dashboard · Source Code · Report an Issue Quickstart npx modern-web-guidance@latest install This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See Alternative Installation Methods below. Try it out (without installing) # Search for relevant guides npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop" # Retrieve a guide by ID npx modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve "animate-to-from-top-layer" # Scan a codebase for legacy patterns to modernize npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan . Why? Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solutions. Even if a model knows an API exists, it often lacks the density of real-world, modern implementation patterns required for production-ready code. Modern Web Guidance bridges this gap. Our skill's CLI returns targeted, expert-curated guidelines directly into your agent's context window, focusing on: Modern Browser APIs: Helping models correctly structure APIs they frequently misuse. Performance & Accessibility: Preferring platform-level APIs that can be optimized by the browser and include built-in accessibility affordances. Responsible Fallbacks: Guiding models to use sensible, lightweight fallbacks instead of heavy polyfills or legacy libraries. What's Included? We cover the past several years of the web platform's new features, all the way up to the cutting edge. The guides are designed to be token-efficient; we run evals enabling us to prune lowest-common-denominator content that models already know. Core Disciplines 🎨 User Experience Smooth visual states (View Transitions, entry/exit animations, parallax scroll, CSS scrollbar-color). 📐 CSS Layout Modern layout systems (container queries, subgrid, modern color spaces like oklch, text-wrap tuning, and line-height trimming). ⚡ Performance Speed optimizations (instant preloading, Interaction to Next Paint (INP) diagnostics, and scheduling tasks via scheduler.yield). 📝 Forms & UI Native components (Anchor Positioning for tooltips, Popover API, dialogs, :user-invalid validation, and auto-sizing fields). ♿ Accessibility Important considerations (screen reader and keyboard operability, content navigation and discoverability). 🤖 Built-in AI Local client models (native translation, summarization, and language detection APIs). View an example: the navigation-drawer guide. anchor-positioning-tab-underline: Transition an element seamlessly between two target element positions. For example, moving a selected tab underline between the previously selected tab and the currently selected tab. animate-element-entry-exit: Smoothly hide/show elements as they are added/removed from the DOM or as their display values are toggled. animate-to-from-top-layer: Animate elements such as dialogs, popovers, and tooltips as they're entering/exiting the top layer. carousel-snap-highlights: Visually highlight the currently snapped non-interactive item in scroll-snapping carousels, galleries, or full-page swipe experiences. For example, expanding a card when snapped, or revealing hidden content. consistent-cross-document-transitions: Ensure critical page state is loaded and stable before initiating a cross-document view transition. This means critical CSS styles are loaded and applied, critical JavaScript is loaded and run, and the HTML visible for the user's initial view of the page has been parsed before the transition runs. cross-document-transitions: Create smooth, seamless transitions between full page navigations, such as cross-fades, custom reveal effects, or morphing of content from one page to the next. custom-button-actions: Declaratively connect a button to any element to trigger custom, application-specific actions using declarative button commands, invoker commands, button commands, custom commands, or declarative toggle actions. declarative-dialog-popover-control: Toggle the visibility of a dialog or popover from a button without writing JavaScript. directional-navigation-transitions: Animate visual state changes to reflect the direction of a user's navigational flow, such as sliding new content in from the right when advancing forward or from the left when returning to a previous screen. drag: Support dragging to move a floating element around the page. drag-and-drop: Support dragging to rearrange the children of a container along one axis (horizontal or vertical) while preserving their state and accessible order. dynamic-sibling-animations: Stagger animation or transition timing across sibling elements so each one starts after a computed delay based on its position in the sibling list. dynamic-sort: Best practices for handling dynamic user-triggered reordering of a container's children (e.g. list items, table rows, or a card grid), with optional animated reordering that respects user preferences, good screen reader UX, and optimal performance for large lists. group-element-transitions: Smoothly rearrange and animate list items, cards, or grid elements into their new positions simultaneously when adding, removing, shuffling, or reordering—such as removing a product from a shopping cart. highlight-text-ranges: Highlight arbitrary text ranges on a page such as search results, spelling errors, or collaborative editing cursors. interactive-content-reveal: Create interactive reveal effects, such as a spotlight that follows the user's pointer to uncover details within an image or UI section. interest-triggered-action-previews: Show a live preview of a button's effect when a user signals interest (e.g. hovering, focusing, or long-pressing) but before they commit to clicking. interest-triggered-tooltips: Show a tooltip or supplemental information when a user hovers over, focuses on, or long-presses an interactive element, without requiring a click. light-dismiss-a-dialog: Create a modal dialog that can be closed via light dismiss (i.e. clicking or tapping outside of the dialog) motion: Animate UI with CSS transitions, animations, scroll-driven animations, and view transitions while keeping motion on the compositor and respecting reduced-motion preferences. move-dom-element-without-losing-state: Move or reparent a DOM element without losing important element state, such as interactivity states (:focus/:active), <iframe> loading state, animation/transition state, etc parallax-scroll-effects: Create scroll-based effects (such as parallax) where foreground and background layers move at different rates, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls. persistent-top-layer-ui: Keep a modal dialog, fullscreen element, or native popover visibly open and functionally active when its underlying DOM node is moved or reparented in the DOM. physics-based-easing: Create custom, physics-based animation and transition effects, like bounce and spring, that feel more natural and engaging than traditional easing curves. platform-controls-dismiss-dialog: Create a modal dialog that can be closed via standard platform-specific user actions, such as pressing the Esc key on desktop platforms, or a "back" or "dismiss" gesture on mobile platforms prevent-page-scroll-under-modal-dialog: Prevent the underlying page from scrolling while a modal dialog is open. same-document-transitions: Visually connect persisting elements across different page states or navigations in a Single Page Application (SPA) (e.g. expanding a product thumbnail into a full-bleed hero image) by smoothly morphing their size, position, or other styling properties. scoped-component-transitions: Animate state changes inside a single component (a card, list, panel, or other subtree) while the rest of the page remains interactive, and other transitions run concurrently. scroll-completion-effects: Trigger visual effects, animations, or focus changes on a target element only after a smooth programmatic scroll to that element has finished. scroll-entry-exit-effects: Create fade-in, scale-up, or other complex reveal-type effects on elements as they enter and exit the scrollport (or viewport) while the user is scrolling. scroll-snap-realtime-feedback: Provide real-time visual feedback in linked UI elements while a user scrolls through snap-aligned content, before the scroll gesture completes. scroll-snap-state-sync: Synchronize navigation indicators, linked content panels, and analytics tracking with the actively snapped item in a scrollable container. scroll-target-on-load: Build a scrollable list of elements (e.g. a carousel of images or a chat conversation thread) that can be displayed with a particular element scrolled into view on the initial render. scrollytelling: Animate visual properties on a target element — such as fading a backdrop, shifting a background color, or to create scrollytelling experiences — driven entirely by the scrollport position of a completely different element. search-hidden-content: Hide content from view using patterns such as accordions, tabs, and "Read more" sections, while ensuring the hidden text reveals itself during native "Find in page" searches, allows search engine indexing, supports URL fragment deep links, and maintains ARIA accessibility. sortable-table: Progressively enhance a data table with behaviors that allow users to sort rows by clicking on column headers. spatial-navigation: Implement accessible spatial navigation using arrow keys that works correctly in different layout modes (grid etc) swipe-to-remove: Let users act on items in a list (remove, archive, mark as read, etc.) with a horizontal swipe gesture, so they can process entries quickly without tapping a separate control. swipe-to-reveal: Let users swipe horizontally on a list item or content pane to reveal contextual action buttons or a side menu without automatically triggering an action. ui-components accordion: Build an accordion component with animation, optional exclusive (one-open-at-a-time) behavior, and brand-consistent styling. app-menus: Build an application menu bar where several top-level menus (such as File, Edit, and View) act as a single keyboard stop and switch between each other on hover or arrow keys. breadcrumbs: Build a breadcrumb trail that shows the user's location within a site hierarchy and lets them navigate to ancestor pages. card: Build a card component that adapts its presentation to its own available space and contents. carousel: Build a carousel component that displays a set of items in a horizontal or vertical layout. checkbox: Style checkboxes, including custom icons, layout, colors, check/uncheck animations, while preserving native functionality and accessibility. copy-button: Build a copy button that copies text from arbitrary elements to the clipboard. dark-mode-toggle: Build a dark mode toggle component that allows users to override their system color scheme preference for the current site. dialog: Build a modal or non-modal dialog component that is accessible, manages focus appropriately, and can be dismissed the way users expect on each platform. hovercard: Build a hovercard component that displays an interactive structured preview of the page a certain type of link (e.g. a user profile) will navigate to when hovered over. menu: Build a menu component that displays a list of options or actions, with support for nested submenus. navbar: Build a site navigation bar that adapts across screen sizes and indicates the current page. navigation-drawer: Create a navigation drawer component that, when triggered from a menu button, slides in from the side overlaid on top of existing page content, and slides out when dismissed (by swiping away, tapping outside, or pressing escape). persistent-app-tours: Create persistent onboarding walkthroughs using tethered native overlays that stay open during user interaction. persistent-toast-notifications: Create non-intrusive toast and overlay notifications for persistent, stackable messaging and state communication. progress: Build a styled progress bar that communicates completion of a task or process, in both determinate and indeterminate states. progress-ring: Build a progress ring component that visually represents the completion status of a task or process, with support for content in the center and brand-consistent styling. scrollspy: Highlight the currently visible section of a page in a navigation menu spinner: Build a loading spinner that communicates busy state to all users, respects reduced-motion preferences, and animates efficiently. stack-drill-down: Build full-screen hierarchical navigation that lets users drill down into nested views and swipe or navigate back to return, with browser history kept in sync. tabs: Build a responsive tabbed interface with good UX when not all tabs fit on screen. toolbar: Build a toolbar component that displays a set of controls for performing actions. user-experience content-first-noise-reduction: Maximize content and reduce noise by removing blocking popups, keeping persistent navigation compact, and moving secondary content behind on-demand disclosure. form-factor-adaptation: Adapt layouts, controls, and text to any device or container so touch targets stay usable, content fits its space, and nothing collides with system UI. natural-interactions: Implement natural interactions with clear hover, focus, and press feedback, motion that opens from its trigger, swipeable content, and keyboard-reachable actions. visual-design adapt-scrollbar-to-contrast-preferences: Enhance scrollbar visibility for users who prefer high-contrast interfaces apply-webgl-shaders: Apply custom visual effects with WebGL shaders to HTML content. browser-ui-theming: Theme browser-generated UI such as text selection, scrollbars, form controls, and pickers with CSS instead of re-creating it with custom elements. color: Color guidance for the web, including contrast requirements, light and dark color schemes, Forced Colors Mode, and generating tints and shades from a base color. complex-shapes: Clip elements and their content to any free-form shape, like a symbol, brush stroke, or organic texture for more expressive designs. contrast-color: Select a readable text color with sufficient contrast on a dynamic background color. custom-text-decorations: Add text decorations such as underlines, overlines, strikethroughs, or entirely custom shapes, with reveal animations, custom offsets and end insets, and flexible ink skipping. customize-scrollbar-color-and-thickness: Customize the color or thickness of a scrollbar dark-mode: Implement dark mode support in a way that respects the user's light/dark theme preference and adapts browser UI (e.g. scrollbars, form controls, etc) equal-width-text-lines: Make every line of a multi-line heading or lockup span the same width, as in poster-style or stacked-headline typography. Unlike justified text, the text itself is sized to the width rather than the spacing stretched export-html-media-from-canvas: Capture and export dynamic HTML content as images or video frames from within canvas. expose-canvas-content-to-browser-features: Expose content rendered in a canvas to browser features like assistive technologies, translation, or reading mode. improve-text-layout-and-legibility: Improve the layout and legibility of short standalone text content, such as headings no longer than a few lines, by enabling the browser to apply evenly balanced line breaks when wrapping text. interactive-content-in-3d-scenes: Integrate interactive HTML elements into a 3D scene. precise-text-alignment: Achieve precise vertical alignment with text of any font. For example, exactly equal visual padding above and below text, or aligning text perfectly flush with adjacent icons or images. shaped-cutouts: Combine multiple shapes to create complex cutouts or 'knockout' effects in elements, such as adding a notch to an element. soft-edge-content-fade: Apply a transparency gradient to content edges to indicate further scrollable areas or to obscure payment-walled text. typography: Typography best practices for the web, including font sizing units, line height, text wrapping and balancing, and fluid type that scales with the viewport. visual-effects: Visual effects with CSS such as layered shadows, blend modes, gradients with predictable color interpolation, and patterns like stripes, checkerboards, dots, and pie charts built from gradients alone. visually-stable-font-fallbacks: Define font styles such that text remains readable and visually consistent in the event that there's a swap between the preferred font and one of the fallbacks (or vice versa). visually-stable-mixed-fonts: Define font styles such that text remains readable and visually consistent in situations where multiple fonts are used to render a single block of text. visually-texture-content: Apply realistic weathering and texture patterns to elements to give them an organic, aged, or physical material appearance. wasm cpp-on-the-web: Compile C/C++ to WebAssembly using Emscripten webmcp agentic-forms: Expose client-side functionality as tools to AI agents by annotating standard HTML forms with WebMCP attributes. agentic-javascript-tools: Programmatically register client-side JavaScript functions as tools for AI agents using the WebMCP Imperative API. webmcp: Use this guide to implement WebMCP in browser applications, exposing client-side functionality as tools to AI agents via declarative or imperative APIs. Safe Adoption of Modern Features Progressive Enhancement & Nuanced Fallbacks: We distinguish between purely additive enhancements (like speculative preloading) which are safe to let older browsers silently ignore, and critical behaviors (like dialog controls or network beacons) where we write highly considered, low-overhead fallbacks. Responsible Fallbacks: We prioritize lightweight, case-specific custom fallbacks ( ". The tool matches the query to the best guide using an offline, zero-dependency embedding model and BM25 search engine (no network calls, no API keys). Guide Fetch: The agent retrieves the guide via modern-web-guidance retrieve , inserting targeted code patterns, gotchas, and fallbacks directly into its context window. Tip Note: We use npx to ensure the content doesn't go stale, but the CLI works offline, completely private and local. The npm package is self-contained, with no extra dependencies to ensure both low-latency and supply-chain security. Otherwise, consult your agent's documentation for updating plugins and skills. Evals to prove this works well We developed a robust eval harness to ensure that the content is empirically proven and continuously calibrated so AI agents write better code. We run automated evaluations using a closed-loop validation pipeline: [ Expert-authored guidance and demo ] │ ▼ [ Target generation ] ──> Tasks on real webapps, Golden solutions, Playwright graders │ ▼ [ Calibration loop ] ───> Runs Grader on Golden Solutions (Must Pass 100%) │ Runs Grader on Unmodified Base App (Must Fail 100%) ▼ [ E2E agent evals ] ────> Runs coding agents in guided vs. unguided modes Compares pass rates and accessibility w/ and w/o the skill Simulated Developer Tasks: We define realistic developer prompts against full base applications (daily-grind, devtools-times) that mimic real-world requests (e.g., "make my images load faster"). Prompts avoid naming APIs or features, testing whether the agent can naturally discover and apply the right guides. Static & Browser-Based Assertions: Playwright graders verify that each implementation requirement was followed—checking source patterns, computed styles, runtime DOM behaviors, and accessibility states. Self-Healing Calibration: Graders are calibrated against multi-agent (Claude/Codex/AGY) golden solutions (100% pass target) and an unmodified baseline application (0% pass target). E2E Testing: We measure coding agent performance on real tasks with and without guidance. The opportunity (100% - unguided pass rate) and uplift (guided - unguided pass rate) are key: if models already succeed without guidance, we prune redundant advice; where agents struggle, we refine guides to maximize uplift. content: https://goo.gle/modern-web-guidance Modern Web Guidance (Source) This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents. Modern Web Guidance is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform. See CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase. Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community. Documentation · Eval Dashboard · Source Code · Report an Issue Quickstart npx modern-web-guidance@latest install This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See Alternative Installation Methods below. Try it out (without installing) # Search for relevant guides npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate a dialog modal backdrop" # Retrieve a guide by ID npx modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve "animate-to-from-top-layer" # Scan a codebase for legacy patterns to modernize npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan . Why? Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solutions. Even if a model knows an API exists, it often lacks the density of real-world, modern implementation patterns required for production-ready code. Modern Web Guidance bridges this gap. Our skill's CLI returns targeted, expert-curated guidelines directly into your agent's context window, focusing on: Modern Browser APIs : Helping models correctly structure APIs they frequently misuse. Performance & Accessibility : Preferring platform-level APIs that can be optimized by the browser and include built-in accessibility affordances. Responsible Fallbacks : Guiding models to use sensible, lightweight fallbacks instead of heavy polyfills or legacy libraries. What's Included? We cover the past several years of the web platform's new features, all the way up to the cutting edge. The guides are designed to be token-efficient ; we run evals enabling us to prune lowest-common-denominator content that models already know. Core Disciplines 🎨 User Experience Smooth visual states (View Transitions, entry/exit animations, parallax scroll, CSS scrollbar-color ). 📐 CSS Layout Modern layout systems (container queries, subgrid , modern color spaces like oklch , text-wrap tuning, and line-height trimming). ⚡ Performance Speed optimizations (instant preloading, Interaction to Next Paint (INP) diagnostics, and scheduling tasks via scheduler.yield ). 📝 Forms & UI Native components (Anchor Positioning for tooltips, Popover API, dialogs, :user-invalid validation, and auto-sizing fields). ♿ Accessibility Important considerations (screen reader and keyboard operability, content navigation and discoverability). 🤖 Built-in AI Local client models (native translation, summarization, and language detection APIs). View an example: the navigation-drawer guide . child elements. For example, a component that renders in light or dark mode based on whether a theme toggle is checked (or not). content-based-styling : Build a component that changes its layout based on whether it contains specific child elements (or not). For example, if the component contains an image, use a multi-column layout, otherwise default to a single-column layout. css : Action-oriented guidelines for modern CSS architecture, including the cascade, selectors, scoping, nesting, and design tokens. Use this guide when authoring styles or managing design systems. css-layout : Modern CSS layouts such as flexbox, grid, subgrid, container queries, anchor positioning, and intrinsic sizing. Use this skill when architecting responsive UI components or page layouts. design-token-reactivity : Define higher-order design tokens, like density modes (compact, comfortable, spacious) or themes and have descendant components react to changes directly and in component-appropriate ways. dynamic-sibling-styling : Create dynamic visual spectrums or layout arrangements that automatically adapt to the number of elements in a group. fluid-scaling : Scale items like font size, spacing, and media sizes smoothly based on the parent container's size rather than using fixed breakpoints individual-transform-properties : Animate or override individual CSS transform properties (e.g. translate, rotate, scale) independently of other transform properties on a single element. overflow-clipping-control : Adjust the visible clipping boundary of an element to align with the content edge, padding edge, or border edge—or a specified offset from any of these—offering finer-grained control over how content is clipped. reduce-style-repetition : Reduce excessive style repetition by encapsulating complex or dynamic styling logic into reusable functions (such as a function that computes a gradient based on a set of input parameters). responsive-design : Build UI that adapts to container and viewport size, including container queries, dynamic viewport units, aspect ratios, and responsive typography. selector-atrule-combinations : Target elements based on the intersection or union of selectors and conditional @-rules while minimizing repetition. size-aware-styling : Build a component whose styles can be conditionally dependent on its own width or height, rather than the width or height of the viewport. For example a card component that can change its layouts depending on how large it is, or a call-to-action button that can conditionally display helper text based on its width. style-parent-with-has : Style parent elements of a form field (e.g. labels or fieldsets) when the field is invalid. usage-aware-component-variations : Build components that adapt visual logic based on semantic context using CSS container style queries. forms animated-select-picker : Create a custom select component whose dropdown is animated. For example, the menu fades or slides into view, or the options animate upon selection. autofill-address-form : Build an address form with correct autocomplete attributes and autofill support. autofill-highlight-inputs : Customize the styling of form fields that have been autofilled and not edited by the user autofill-payment-form : Build a payment form that collects card details with correct autocomplete values and autofill support. autofill-sign-in-form : Build a sign-in form with correct autocomplete values and autofill support. autofill-sign-up-form : Build a sign-up form with correct autocomplete values and autofill support. brand-consistent-forms : Match checkboxes, radio buttons, range sliders, and progress bars to your site's color palette without replacing them with custom components. branded-select-styling : Create custom select elements whose button, picker, arrow icon, and checkmark all seamlessly match your brand or design system's typography, colors, spacing, and border treatments. custom-select-picker-layouts : Create custom select pickers whose options are positioned in unique or interesting ways, rather than the traditional stacked list of options. form-fields-automatically-fit-contents : Allow form fields to grow and shrink to fit the user input, e.g. as the user types or selects a different option. Apply maximum and minimum size limits to create dynamic and responsive form fields that conform with the page design. ime-safe-enter-submit : Implement Enter-to-submit in textareas and single-line Safe Adoption of Modern Features Progressive Enhancement & Nuanced Fallbacks : We distinguish between purely additive enhancements (like speculative preloading) which are safe to let older browsers silently ignore, and critical behaviors (like dialog controls or network beacons) where we write highly considered, low-overhead fallbacks. Responsible Fallbacks : We prioritize lightweight, case-specific custom fallbacks (<50 LOC) or conditionally-loaded polyfills instead of heavy third-party bundles. Gotchas & Quirks : We document hidden platform limitations, such as the 64KB payload quota for fetchLater() or macOS-specific scrollbar behaviors. Baseline-Aware Integration : We leverage real-time compatibility data from the Baseline project so agents dynamically adapt to current browser support. Origin Trial & Volatile Feature Gates : Guides covering experimental Origin Trial APIs or volatile features (single-engine features shipped within the last 3 months or still stabilizing) remain discoverable via search , but are gated on retrieve so agents do not adopt unstable APIs without explicit developer consent. Project Configuration ( .mwgrc ) Configure Origin Trial and volatile feature opt-ins for a repository with an optional .mwgrc JSON file in your project root (or ~/.mwgrc as a user-level fallback), which you can commit to share across your team: CLI Command .mwgrc Key Effect npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-origin-trials "allowOriginTrials": true Unlocks guides for experimental Origin Trial APIs. npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-volatile-features "allowVolatileFeatures": true Unlocks guides for volatile single-engine features. Local Semantic Search : The agent runs modern-web-guidance search "<query>" . Evals to prove this works well We developed a robust eval harness to ensure that the content is empirically proven and continuously calibrated so AI agents write better code. We run automated evaluations using a closed-loop validation pipeline: [ Expert-authored guidance and demo ] │ ▼ [ Target generation ] ──> Tasks on real webapps, Golden solutions, Playwright graders │ ▼ [ Calibration loop ] ───> Runs Grader on Golden Solutions (Must Pass 100%) │ Runs Grader on Unmodified Base App (Must Fail 100%) ▼ [ E2E agent evals ] ────> Runs coding agents in guided vs. unguided modes Compares pass rates and accessibility w/ and w/o the skill Simulated Developer Tasks : We define realistic developer prompts against full base applications ( daily-grind , devtools-times ) that mimic real-world requests (e.g., "make my images load faster"). Prompts avoid naming APIs or features, testing whether the agent can naturally discover and apply the right guides. Static & Browser-Based Assertions : Playwright graders verify that each implementation requirement was followed—checking source patterns, computed styles, runtime DOM behaviors, and accessibility states. Self-Healing Calibration : Graders are calibrated against multi-agent (Claude/Codex/AGY) golden solutions (100% pass target) and an unmodified baseline application (0% pass target). E2E Testing : We measure coding agent performance on real tasks with and without guidance. The opportunity (100% - unguided pass rate) and uplift (guided - unguided pass rate) are key: if models already succeed without guidance, we prune redundant advice; where agents struggle, we refine guides to maximize uplift. title: shadcn/improve
description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute. improve An agent skill that audits any codebase and writes implementation plans for other agents to execute. The idea: use your most capable model for the part where intelligence compounds — understanding the codebase, judging what's worth doing, writing the spec — and hand execution to cheaper models. The skill never implements anything itself. The plan is the product. you → /improve (expensive model, advises) plans/ → 001-fix-n-plus-one.md (self-contained specs) other agent → implements, tests, ships (cheap model, executes) Install npx skills add shadcn/improve Works in any agent that supports Agent Skills format. The plans it writes are plain markdown, so any agent (or human) can pick them up. Usage /improve full audit → prioritized findings → plans /improve quick cheap pass: hotspots, top findings only /improve deep exhaustive: every package, every category /improve security focused audit (also: perf, tests, bugs, ...) /improve branch audit only what the current branch changes /improve next feature suggestions — where to take the project /improve plan skip the audit, spec one thing /improve review-plan critique and tighten an existing plan /improve execute dispatch a cheaper executor, review its work /improve reconcile refresh the backlog: verify, unblock, retire /improve ... --issues also publish plans as GitHub issues How to use A typical first run, start to finish: Open your agent in the repo and run /improve (or /improve quick to keep it cheap). It maps the repo, audits it, and comes back with a findings table. Reply with the ones you want planned — "plan 1, 3 and 5". Plans land in plans/ — one file each, plus an index with the recommended order. Read them; they're meant to be reviewed. Hand a plan to any agent ("implement plans/001-*.md"), or let the skill run it: /improve execute 001. It dispatches a cheaper model in an isolated worktree, reviews the diff against the plan, and reports back with a verdict. Merging stays up to you. Next session, run /improve reconcile to clean up the backlog: verify what landed, refresh what drifted, unblock what got stuck. Before a PR, /improve branch does the same thing scoped to just what your branch changes. Example A run against shadcn/ui came back with findings like: | # | Finding | Category | Effort | Confidence | |---|------------------------------------------------|-----------|--------|------------| | 1 | shadow-config duplicated in search.ts/view.ts, | tech-debt | M | HIGH | | | copies already drifted (TODO at search.ts:31) | | | | | 2 | O(n²) icon migration (migrate-icons.ts:168) | perf | S | HIGH | …and rejected a few, with reasons recorded so they don't come back next run: - [SEC-01] https_proxy env var "SSRF": by-design — standard proxy convention, every CLI honors it. Not a finding. Picking #1 produced this plan — current code excerpted, exact steps, the repo's own test/lint commands as verification gates, and STOP conditions for when reality doesn't match. How it works Recon. Maps the repo: stack, conventions, and the exact build/test/lint commands — these become verification gates in every plan. It also ingests intent and design docs when present — ADRs (docs/adr/), PRDs, CONTEXT.md, DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md — so decided tradeoffs aren't re-flagged as findings, direction suggestions stay grounded in stated product intent, and plans speak the repo's own vocabulary. Composes with any repo that already maintains these docs. Audit. Fans out parallel subagents across nine categories: correctness, security, performance, test coverage, tech debt, dependencies & migrations, DX, docs, and direction (feature suggestions — every one must cite evidence from the repo itself, no generic idea-slop). Every finding carries file:line evidence, impact, effort, and confidence. Vet. Subagents over-report, so the advisor re-reads every cited location itself before showing you anything — false positives get dropped, wrong attributions get corrected, rejections get recorded. Prioritize. Findings land in a table ordered by leverage (impact ÷ effort, weighted by confidence). You pick what becomes plans. Plan. One file per selected finding, written into plans/ with an index, priority order, and dependency graph. What makes the plans executable Plans are written for the weakest plausible executor — a model that has never seen the advisor session and may be much smaller. Three properties carry that: Self-contained. All context is inlined: exact file paths, current-state code excerpts, repo conventions with an exemplar file, verified commands. No "as discussed above." Verification gates. Every step ends with a command and its expected output. Done criteria are machine-checkable. The executor never has to judge whether it succeeded. Hard boundaries. Explicit out-of-scope lists, and STOP conditions — "if X, stop and report" — instead of letting a small model improvise when reality doesn't match the plan. Each plan also stamps the git commit it was written against, so executors run a mechanical drift check before touching anything. Closing the loop Plans aren't fire-and-forget: execute spawns a cheaper executor subagent in an isolated git worktree, hands it the plan, then reviews the result like a tech lead — re-runs every done criterion, checks scope compliance, reads the diff against intent. Verdict: approve (merging stays your call), send back for revision (max 2 rounds), or block and refine the plan. reconcile processes what happened since: verifies DONE plans still hold, investigates BLOCKED ones and rewrites around the obstacle, refreshes drifted plans, retires findings that got fixed independently. --issues publishes plans as GitHub issues — same self-contained body, so any agent or human can pick them up where work already lives. Hard rules Never modifies source code itself. The only writes go to plans/; executors edit only in disposable worktrees, and merging is always yours. Never runs commands that mutate your working tree — read, search, and read-only analysis only. Never reproduces secret values. Locations and credential types only, rotation always recommended. Asked to implement? It declines and points at the plan (or offers execute). License MIT © shadcn
